On our way out be sure to grab a take out of that fried galamah with hot sauce, trust me when I say, you will be craving for it later. Say hello to Paulie.

Hadn't been there for some time and I'm sorry to say the food seemed to have gone downhill. My mother in law had the lobster bisque and didn't like it.  She only had a couple of spoonfuls and left the rest. My wife had the spicy crab corn soup and didn't like that. I tasted it,  it was meh. I had little neck clams, they were very good. 

I had scungili over linguini. It was okay but had very little scungili. My wife got the lobster roll and didn't like that either. She had them wrap it just to be polite but threw it out when we got home. My father had fried calamari. I tasted it, it was ok but nothing special. He ordered it because they wouldn't accommodate his request for combining scungili and calamari over linguini (something they had done in the past). He was willing to pay extra but they wanted him to order 2 meals. 

Overall there were some hits and some serious misses. Definitely disappointing, especially considering the prices and the stellar days of the past.

I went there one evening with a guy I was seeing. I never eat meat, only fish and it's usually seafood. This place has changed. I ordered a seafood platter.. Had a bit of everything and it was horrible. I didn't say anything only because what is there to say? I didn't want anything else and the place has been around long enough to show me some good and some bad food. 

I just hated going there after such a while and having such a disappointing experience.

Visited Randazzo's today.  It was my first time there after a coworker recommended it. I am a crab cake lover and having lived abroad and along the lower east coast several years back know a good crab cake.  I ordered the crab cakes even though I like them broiled than fried.   They need to clean the oil if this is how they do it. It had a bit of burnt oil taste. They were made with lump crab meat and some sort of breading that I was not a fan of. Not much to wow about.  I have made better myself.  But what I don't understand is why served on hamburger role.  Why would I want to place it in a bun.  Anyway, it was just ok. Smaller than I envisioned and VERY expensive for what you get $18 bucks for two patties!  The banked potato was right on spot though not over baked or lets say twice banked.  I guess I got lucky.  They serve you water in this small toddler cup that I had to refill a dozen times. It was the size of the dentist doctors rinse cup. Oh, I had a small cup of lobster bisque that was good. Again over priced $8 bucks and one piece of meat in it. In the end, over priced and not impressed.  I know, this is NY, well it can be better.  Just because it is a long time establishment does not mean they are the best. I don't think I will go back.
Went there once and never again..over priced and lacking flavor. . They should be thankful for the location.

Fried galamah with THE sauce is a home run.  Must admit that I stay with the basics here while sitting at the bar watching Emilio run the tight ship that it is.
Love this place!
There is no better for oysters and clams !!!! If u want fresh this is your place ,, everyone must go

Came here yesterday with a few friends  I first ordered the lobster bisque soup.  It was delicious! 

Next we all shared fried calamari and fried clams.  The calamari was pretty good but I wasn't crazy about the fried clams. It was way to crunchy for me.  

Then me and a friend shared the shrimp fra diavolo. It was good but way to garlicky for me. And I like a lot of garlic! Make sure you have tums with you!

Came to brooklyn visit my family. I was craving for Oyster and clams for days !!! So i looked online and this place seems the closest.  Went in for a try and their oysters and clams were so fresh that i have to order another dozen.
Never disappoints! Lobster was so fresh... Been going there since I was a kid. Love it! So many things change in BK, but not here :)
My favorite restaurant. Been coming here since I was a kid. Over 25 years. The calamari are delicious, really good lobster bisque. And the sauce is the best.

The place to go for seafood in this area. If you want a New York experience this is the place. I love the waitresses and the owner true bklyn foregetaboutit experience. Ive been coming here throughout the years. My first time back was sunday june 1st since hurricane Sandy. Its like they weren't affected but they were. We had oysters and Zuppa Di Mussels in red sauce. I just recently aquired a taste for both after having the freshest ones in VA.and they were as fresh and delicious.  There spaghetti sauce is the bomb too. If we didnt have a large meal at another place not even worth mentioning we would have ordered more.
Awesome sea food!  The calamari and house sauce is a favorite.  Their motto is "Cheap seafood isn't good, and good seafood isn't cheap!"

Its literally A-OK. Not horrendous, but not the best. They have their bad days, they have their good days. The baked clams aren't so bad. Its pretty awkward when you order then lobster roll and you eat it and think, they might have forgotten to put lobster in it..it was all bread!

Its over priced, and you're on Emmons Avenue, theres a lot of seafood to choose from!

The food here is good. The salmon over salad is delish. Also the shrimp scampi is to die for. It's a no frills type of Resturant. Someplace you go and eat not to get fancy lol. You get big potions and go home happy. Go with a empty stomach and a love for seafood!

My favorite restaurants are those that are not super fancy but have really great food, and Randazzo's is that to the letter. The raw bar selections are super fresh and reasonably priced, , the waitresses are of the old-school no-nonsense no-frills type but are also perfectly nice and attentive, the fried calamari is plentiful and perfectly golden, the pasta entrees are ridiculously big and covered in amazing sauces, the lobster rolls are delicious, and so on. 

The only thing I don't like are the scungilli (but I've never had it anywhere else, I think I just don't like scungilli) and the rock-hard bread that comes with the calamari (but I'll still gnaw on it as a way to get more red sauce in my mouth.)

This is three kind of place you hear about a lot but you can never remember where you heard it. My friend and I decided to try it tonight. We drove in from Midtown and it was pretty easy to find.

We were seated right away and our waitress was nice. That's about it though. It took forever to have our order taken and when we would ask a member of the waitstaff for something, he or she always turned around and loudly delegated someone else the task. When we got our food, the portions were itty bitty and the pasta was super bland.

It is nice and roomy inside and it has the fun sort of atmosphere you expect from a classic neighborhood restaurant, but the hype was lost on us.

The hot sauce is awesome!! I got it on some mussels and could have slathered it all over my body. Clams are just right and the vibe is even better (Russians who couldn't care what to recommend. "Whatever you want honey!" ) Next time, I'll come with more people so we (read: I) can get a ton of fried baskets.

Amazing food! 


The food is spectacular! 

The decor leaves a lot to be desired. If you are with friends and looking for great seafood this is a great choice.

I come here weekly if time permits it. The saying "you get what you pay for" applies here 100%. The prices are not cheap but the food is not only authentic but deserves an A+ rating. Restaurant runs like clock work. Tables for 1 or 2, 5-8, including an outside seating area. Awesome stuffed lobster, clams, oysters, pasta, soup. Its the whole package. Beer and bar seating available. Located in the heart of Emmons Ave Sheepshead Bay, 11235. My favorite dish or bowl I should say is the lobster bisque.

I found Randazzo years ago and to date I always manage to find my way here whenever I have that seafood craving. I always find street parking a few blocks away. Know that this place gets packed on weekends, especially on those warm summer days.

If you're searching for fine dining, this is not the place. No white linens, reservations or five course meals. They do however have great food and service. The waitresses work hard at what they do and always serve you with a smile. 

The calamari with spicy marinara sauce is to die for (very crispy, well seasoned, and not overcooked), I don't see the point of the fried bread but the plate is delicious nonetheless. While your at it, why not try the fried zucchini. I would also recommend the shrimp fra diavallo and the fried soft shell crabs.
Okay let's go back to that spicy marinara sauce, it's spicy and taste like heaven in my mouth. I'd lick my plate if I could. It's like gold! Should I go on? 

The saying cheap is not always better holds true. They provide quality seafood at a fair price. 

Pro-tip: In the summer I would order food to go and take it to Manhattan Beach, which is a few minutes drive. There is always parking on the street during weekdays to avoid the crowd.

Way overpriced, terrible food. I went here on a recommendation from good friends. I had never been to this restaurant and heard it was great, it has been around for years. So I got the clam chowder which seemed tasteless and watered down. Then we got the calamari, and I am sure it was frozen - I've cooked fresh calamari enough to know. The shrimps in hot sauce was extremely expensive. The service was very rude, and the place was packed! I guess I just don't understand this place. I would never go back nor would I ever recommend any friends.

Love the food. The service is the rudest I have ever experienced. Waitress just threw my plate down in front of me, didn't ask if I needed anything else and walked away while I was in the middle of still ordering food. I have never felt more disrespected and never want to go back again no matter how good the seafood is.
Food is overpriced. Fried clam was literally all dough. Fried calamary and baked clam was o.k. nothing special. Will not be coming back anytime soon. Waitress was nice though.
My family and I when it comes to wanting seafood this is our spot. If your're looking for fancy dining dont bother but for delicious food this is the place.

This is a great seafood restaurant that isn't very fancy but their food is amazing. It's a good place to go with family and friends. We started off with some New England clam chowders and lobster bisque which were both delicious but the chowder is definitely better. The steamers are probably the best dish we ordered. We ordered 3 plates because it was THAT good. Their raw oysters and raw clams were also very fresh. There wasn't one thing the family ordered that didn't taste great. I'd recommend this place to anybody who's looking for great quality seafood. Only thing that bothered us was that they were going to give us a table closer to the inside but instead gave us a table right next to their side door and every time people came in and out the wind would blow everything on our table but other than that can't really complain :p

It's my first time coming here and it might just become one of my favorite seafood restaurant. Came here with my family so we got to try different dishes. The best I would say the STEAMERS!! It was delicious with the salted butter dip. We also had cherry stones and oysters. They were fresh but wasn't mouth watering. The calamari was great. We also tried the soups. We had the New England clam chowder and lobster bisque. My whole family liked the New England clam chowder better but I loved the lobster bisque lol we also had the randazzo lobster sauce pasta. Best pasta ever!!! The only bad dish I had today was the fried oysters. It was tiny and mostly I taste flour. It wasn't anything special. But the steamers and pasta is a MUST come back for . ;)

Been coming here for years .... Seafood pasta dishes are always excellent .. Fried calamari is good but a bit expensive for the amount they give u. Their sauce is delicious .. Have always had very good service. If decor is ur thing u will be disappointed ... But if it's good seafood u want , then you'll enjoy Randazzo's

I came here because a friend recommended, said it'll be family friendly, which it was. Food was decent, atmosphere was very casual. For families who have young children, it's probably not the best place because there were group of people drinking just two tables away. Waitress were friendly overall.  
I have a family of four, we ordered one appetizer, two entrees and two soups and left a little hungry. Probably one more appetizer would be better.

Years ago if you would of asked my favorite restaurant I would of quickly answered Randazzos. Me and my family would come here every summer and have dozens of clams and oysters with delicious other selections of sea food. Unfortunately the new management there is very rude, I was there for my birthday and received two dozen clams that were rotted.. I silently told the waitress about the issue asking to simply have it taken off the bill given we ordered plenty of other food and I could not eat them(keep in mind, my favorite food!!) She did so but shortly after, some tough guy strutted up to my table with his hands folded and proceeded to tell me: "i'm going to be nice and take the clams off the bill, BUT just so you know, clams come from the sea that's why they taste like that" he argued with me in front of other customers, it was very disrespectful. I was not giving an attitude whatsoever he just felt the need to belittle me to justify his rotten clams. Never going back, it's a shame and I'm saddened to say it. I would never write a bad review if unnecessary but this guy totally ruined my mood. Be warned! Don't send back food! Or you'll be scolded by the big boss in the back! Real shame.. They used to know me and my family by name when we walked in.

I've been going to this place for years, by far the best and freshest seafood in sheepshead bay, it's family ran business.  The whole family are passionate and loveable. Every time I go there I'm welcomed as if I was one of the family... please check them out, you definitely won't be disappointed.

Literally disgusting. Cold steamers, inedible clam strips that appeared to be missing the clams, and piece of "bread" they called a "biscuit" which looked like it was retrieved from the trash a week ago, and tasted like it.

Great seafood.  One of the best in Brooklyn.    Go with the oysters.   Calamari kicks butt. Lobster for champions.  Definitely order the Baked clams   
Come with yur appetite.  
Service great.   Dining area is a little tight, but worth the sacrifice.
The worst seafood i took in my life, the sevice wa very bad too , i do not understand why so many people review good

it is the worst place i have never been before. Bad service attitude, food was expensive. there was advertise 54 dollar/3 lobster , but they told us  they did not supply today after we arranged a table there.
Food is good, servers were nice but i could have ate more for ALOT LESS and i got the crappiest table out of the whole place.
Decent seafood , steamers were okay . Clam chowder was really good . Service is crappy , took 15 minutes just to take the order.

Freshest, meatiest crab cakes I have ever tried. Love the old school feel, where I think the elderly waitresses may smack the young men on the back of the neck if they don't act properly. The chowder is delicious, love the spices, but very filling. Don't have it if you're going sailing after.
Food was the primary reason for coming here, but after my last two or three times eating here, I will never return. Here's a good comparison: I'd rather pay for bad italian food from a diner.
BEST SAUCE EVER ! Love the food as well as the service my parents have been coming here for 27 years and I've been going since a kid by far the best place for family dinners

The only reason I'm not giving them 5 stars is because the place could use a make over, but the food is fresh and delicious and the waiters attentive.  We go for the best calamari and scungilli on the planet. The secret is definitely "the Randazzo sauce."
Very comfortable eating here. The food was great. Cant wait to come back and try the soup and pasta. The waitress was nice.

Food is great! Friendly atmosphere, family owned & operated. You can see the family love in every corner of the place and especially in their food. The best calamari in town! The sause is awesome. Oysters are my husband's favorite. All their soups are great. Pasta is delicious. King crab legs & colossal shrimps are my two favorites. I would not eat seafood unless it's at Randazzo's!

I've been eating here for 30 years. I always have the  same linguine marinara and fried calamari on the side. 
But there's no owner around. No  manager to control the dunking women yelling and showing her boobs and ass to everyone. Bad for BUSSINESS.

Very delicious! very fresh! and the waitress was very nice.I wanna come here again! The oysters were great, soup too, clams,crab cakes were ordered it all!!!!! This place is great. The decor is mehhh. But it doesn't matter. The food is great!!! They bring the food pretty fast!!! 

I would recommend for a family. Not a romantic date. Dress casual!

Randazzzzzzoos,
What more can i say than, you guys ROCK
food is amazing, always consistent 
I always order the fried Calamari,
Little necks, Loster DaFlabio, etc
And its absolutely the best
Been going here for over 10years and i will
Continue to go for many more years to come

It was my first visit to Randazzo's last Saturday. I granted them only 3 stars as I did not find anything special in the taste of dishes they serve for a rather bigger price. I ordered shrimps parmigana, where breaded shrimps (the taste of bread, no shrimps) and pasta bathed in marinara sauce. On my opinion it was too much sauce. My Family ordered Alaskan Crabs, which were very tasty, but the price was not shown in the menu. It was written that the price fluctuates depending on market situation. Finally the dish was $38, but my son liked it. We ordered also Manhattan clam chowder and new England clam chowder, where the last won. Fried Calamari were tender and mouthwatering too. Final price for 3 was $103 + tips, which is a bit much, considering that the dining area is very far from cozy Red Lobster places.
The shrimp parmesan was yummylicous. Marinara sauce was W.O.W.Old world Italian seafood that's been serving Sheepshead Bay for as long as I can remember.
Best Calamari and sauce ever! Def go here and try it, you will not be disappointed. Chicken parmigiano with pasta and homeade sauce delicious. Shrimp Fri davolo, has mussels also in it, just yummy.
Love this place every time i come here its a hit .nevrer was a bad or unpleasant expirience .thank you guys

I'm not that familiar with too many clam bars. OK, so this was the first and only one that I've ever visited. What can I say? Though I like seafood, I'm not a clam person, but, I have to say that I was pleasantly surprised with the quality of the food here. Just on a whim, a group of friends and I found ourselves in the mood for seafood. So off we went in search for lunch. And, well, after a few keystrokes on yelp we settled on Randazzo. There's not much to say here for ambiance. Nothing visually stimulating or worth dressing up for, but the service and the food made up for it. From the fried calamari appetizer to the crab cakes, salmon, fried shrimp and lobster, we were all VERY satisfied!

Greeting- yes
Vibe- old school sea warrior
Parking- street meters
Bathroom- fail
Wine list - fail. $5 mini bottles. $25 bottles. Low end juice.
Service- friendly yet inattentive. Waitresses gabbing in back of room. 
Price- nice
Table bread- good, hot Italian bread
Food
Manhattan clam chowder $5  cup is excellent. Great amount of clams and vegetables
- fresh baked clams $13 for 10. Very good
- steamed fresh  clams $13 dozen.very good with melted butter
- scungilli  $19.95. Too expensive. From a can?
- fried scallops were horrid! Avoid by all means. Tasted like from the school cafeteria 
- burned chicken  $11.95. Randazzo version of scarparello. Ok
- French fries were ok. 
- zucchini fries nice and crispy. Better than above.
Dessert- no desserts served here
WIGB? Yes

Overall this is what Brooklyn used to be about. The prices are much better than the Grand Central Oyster Bar. The food is the same quality if not better. Stick to the basics here and you will be satisfied.

If you are in sheepshead bay and you love seafood. Do yourself a favor: go here.... a lot. Try everything. Down to earth staff. Eat inside or out. Everyone is attentive, but remember...Brooklyn is gruff!

came here on christmas eve with some friends for lunch and was seated right away.  had some steamers, calamari, lobster rolls, crab cake burger, and one of the seafood pasta dishes.  Overall the food is ok/good, nothing too special.  The steamers had some sand in them so ehhhh.  The calamari was normal.  The lobster rolls were big but only ok.  The crab cake burger was not bad.  The seafood pasta was pretty good.  The food is pricer than I thought it should have been but not crazy.  The service was good but there weren't many customers when I went.

I love coming here with my family they food is great, it's a bit pricy. If you come on a weekend you will have to wait to get seated, you wont be seated right away because so many people come to eat here. The waiter are amazing. I just love coming here.

If you love seafood this is the place,  their sauce is very nice,  I have to say much better than the ozone park place,  Don peppe.
Fresh seafood is not cheap and cheap seafood is not fresh,  clearly hanging sign near the bar and I agree. Give it a try and afterwards walk of your food coma  by the bay.

Overpriced. Ordered fried calamari, lobster bisque and spicy crab corn chowder. Not satisfied with the quality at all. Nothing special to blow your mind. Calamari were somewhat mushy...not sure if i ever go back.
The food is amazing! I haven't tasted anything else like the Clam Chowder. The Calamari was so delicious as well. Definitely recommended to seafood lovers.

Who doesn't love Randazzo's? The spicy marinara, baby! That's the stuff. Thick & rich with just the right amount of oiliness. Perfecto! Try toppin that. You can't! And the seafood, always fresh & likewise done to perfection. Sure, you'll drop a little $. So what? Live a little.

The only reason why this restaurant is even getting 2 stars is because they have decent cherrystones.

The service was terrible and food is overpriced. Sat down for 15 minutes and no one came around to take our order. It would've been understandable if it was busy, but you see waitresses standing around doing nothing. I literally had to flag one down just for her to say "hold on".

The fried oyster sandwich was not worth $18. It was served with a baked potato (or fries) and the sandwich consisted of small deep fried oysters which was mainly dough. 

The 1/2 order linguine with marinara sauce was okay, on a scale out of 10, I give it a 6. Pasta was al dente and sauce was flavorful. 

I probably will not return to this place in the future unless I'm in Brooklyn and I am REALLY craving to have some clams, wouldn't order anything else from here.

This was my first time having dinner here and i was pleasantly surprised. Laid back atmosphere, friendly and attentive staff and AMAZING food. Our waitress, Amy, was a doll. And the Lobster Fra Diavolo(forgive me if i spelled it wrong)was a perfect.

TOURIST TRAP - Horrifically  BEYOND gross! 
They shamelessly profit from a defunct rep from eons ago, when I was a kid!
Ironically, almost any place in Central Coast California has far better & cheaper seafood, where good Clam Chowder has plenty of Clams....& the Calamari are at least edible!

It is NOT even to close to the undead version of Randazzo's back in the 1970-80's!

My mom, who is fighting for her life, existence, & consciousness (e.g. in delirium), at nearby Menorah Rehab Nursing Home (an Oxymoron?), used to treat me to 

a 

real Maine Lobster dinner 

here, at their long defunct fancy restaurant part of Randazzo's....

for which most of you do not remember.  

They even used to have candlelight on the table & heated draw butter!

The only custom that remains is that they put a bib on you.

Yes, as I understand it, it was about eight years ago that Randazzo's was said to be obligated to give up space to the city & downsize to their present pathetic condition.

Long ago, when I did straight A's at elementary school, my wonderful beautiful mom, would collect the pennies around the house & treat me, to a once a year lobster dinner, at the now defunct restaurant (fancy) part of Randazzo's.  

It is shear blasphemy to suggest that what they have now, in this fast food grossness "has been", can even hold a candle to what was! WAS!!!!  

Even, later, as a foolish teenager, Randazzo's was a beacon of great seafood in NYC.  There was many a weekend night where my 37th street & Flatlands Ave. crew would cruise down there to get a late night Calamari delight.

Fast forward to the future (the present)....& you will find worse than inedible way overpriced crap!  

While the pathetic excuse for clam chowder was merely horridly insipid, the Calamari was absolutely the worst that I had ever tasted! 

 The so-called "Baked Clams" were simply cooked clams with insipid tasteless soggy (not crispy) "cooked" breadcrumb crap on top.  I had to fish out both the clams (& dump the soggy breadcrumbs) & scrape out the tasteless squid (from the tasteless mass of greasy pseudo-Tempura-like crappy batter) to at least get the equivalent of maybe a pathetic appetizer!

Even after scraping off both the batter & the sauce, the Calamari were soft, but lacked flavor.  It could be that all that batter & sauce was hiding some cheap previously frozen Squid from only God knows where.

Service, was even worse than some fast food places.  The waitress never asked me if I wanted more water, nor asked me how I was doing.  I had to flag down a bus boy just to get 6 oz. more of tap water.

I cannot believe that I have been busting balls on the other coast & in Hawaii, bragging about the virtues of "Brooklyn's great seafood", when this unspeakable culinary apocalypse happens today of all days.....when my mom is probably dying of delirium at a very nearby "Nursing Home", that I just had the displeasure of visiting.

As I sit scraping off the crap that they obfuscated the poor excuse of Squid (that was hidden under layers & tons of greasy breading & insipid sauce), that they had the balls to call

CALAMARI!!!!

I HAD ENOUGH, ......and I told them to throw it out......since it was both gross & a true NYC rip-off!

After ordering about $50 of stuff which I trashed, they were even reluctant to refill a small 6 oz. plastic cup of tap water x 1.  

Their pathetic excuse for not having hot water in sub-zero weather was.... "We do not serve dessert"? 

WHAT....ARE YOU NOT TOTAL IMBECILEs?  

You mean that I can not order a hot cup of water, tea, or coffee.... for WHAT reason!

You can somehow amazingly heat up your crappy chowder to above room temperature & you 

CANNOT

FIGURE OUT HOW TO HEAT WATER....WHEN IT IS BELOW ZERO OUTSIDE!!!!

It is not bad enough;
 to virtually "rape" me with your crappy overpriced seafood, 

but you dare to insult me with the idea that you cannot give me warm,

 nor hot water....


so that you can sell me & others some crappy pricey COLD CRAP on one of the coldest days of the year!

WOW..... thanks!

AREN'T YOU SPECIAL!!!!

Horrid! My boyfriend and I had such high hopes for this place instead we had soggy salt less baked clams. unfortunately we also ordered the frozen bright orange fried clams with the pre-packaged tartar sauce chock full of high fructose corn-syrup. It's supposedly a renowned clam bar and they can't make their own tartar sauce???If I wanted frozen clams, Gortons fisherman's in the freezer section of shop-rite is better and cheaper to boot. $34 dollars for 8 baked clams and an order of fried crap. 
maybe we just ordered wrong? I will never go back to this restaurant. please heed my warning and save your money or at least do not order the above menu items. i.e the clams and what a pity from a CLAM bar.

Nice place to go to on a summer day or night and sit outside or walk along the water. 

Benches outside, but lots of bugs. This place gets very crowded too.

The clams are good. Had the pasta here too..it's okay. Definitely had better.

Recent visit has proven that they still have the best fried calamari in Brooklyn hands down...Love my Brooklyn peeps and some of the waitresses have been there forever.  Had their lobster roll for the first time and the meat was succulent. I even brought a order of their medium sauce home to make stuffed peppers. Delish!!!

Long time listener, first time caller, er, diner. Clean plain decor. Friendly vibe. Excellent clams, soups and fries. Good but pricey oysters and soft shell crabs. I know, good seafood is expensive but this place takes advantage on those premium items. So? If you want it, buy it and pay. Still cheaper and better than GCT's Oyster Bar. Or, you can cross the street and catch your own from a party boat.

A Brooklyn institution. Sure, the waitresses (mostly iconoclastic Brooklyn Italian mothers and grandmothers)  are just trying to make it through the night. And why should you want to drink out of anything other than a plastic cup?  But, the food is "to die for".  Just don't expect a fancy joint. Definitely go for the lobster bisque, plain fried shrimp (with hot sauce...and it comes with a "biscuit" which is a lightly fried piece of bread) and an order of spaghetti with the hot sauce (a half order usually does it). And, their fried fish sandwich shouldn't be as good as it is...but believe me it IS!  Be sure to enjoy the crowd too. It has been (and always will be) a cross section of Brooklyn's population...all enjoying a great seafood meal down in Sheepshead Bay!

Story time: my mother grew up in Brooklyn and this particular place used to be called Joe's.  It used to be a favorite of my mothers's along with lundys which used to be down the block.
Joes has obviously since been bought over and unfortunately not for the better, per my mom.  In all fairness, I was not impressed with anything here at all.


It is a very no frills, cafeteria like seating arrangement and you will be almost haphazardly seated.
The menu items are pricey which would not have been a problem if the quality of food had been equivalent which it was not.

I started with a $6 house salad which was disappointing and not worth the money.

We split an order of steamers which were the only good thing we ordered.

For my entree I had the shrimp randazzo which had shrimp, clams, mussels over pasta in a butter, lemon, garlic wine sauce.  Sounds delish right?!   Ehhhh
It literally lists how many shrimp, clams and mussels are to be in the dish.   The pasta was swimming in an overly watery sauce and the clams and mussels were dry.  I've never had a dry shellfish before!  I was disappointed.
 My mom had a shrimp dish with a side of pasta and the medium red sauce.  Boy was she disappointed!  I can't say that I blame her either.   The sauce was sweet and actually had a plastic like taste to it as if it were jarred sauce.  No Bueno.

Finally, to add insult to injury the service was  shoddy and slow.  They were nice though so that's one plus.

I can't imagine that I will return to this venue.

I went there around 6pm on a Sunday, the place was so busy! But we were seated really quickly. The place is spacious and very open, with outdoor seating. It's a really casual setting, I can't imagine how packed the place would be during the summer.

I was really craving some raw seafood so my boyfriend and I ordered half dozen of cherry stones and half dozen of raw oysters. Boy, was it fresh. The oysters came out to around $2.50 a piece, can be pricey but it's worth it. 

Aside from the raw bar, we ordered linguine with red clam sauce, mozzarella sticks, and crab cake sandwich with fries. 
The pasta was average - nothing too special other than the amount of clams in the sauce. Every bite, I had clams - it was wonderful! 
The mozzarella sticks was very warm and crunchy. They hit the spot! 
Finally, the crab cake sandwich! One order comes with two crab cakes on a bun, with fries and cole slaw. The crab cake was filled with crab, soo much crab! Although tasty, I felt that it was overcooked - the outside was too hard and tasted burnt. 

Overall, it was a great meal and great atmosphere! Definitely come here if you are craving seafood! Next time I go, I'm definitely trying the mussels and calamari - every single table had these items!
Very good fried seafood and raw bar. The food is fresh. Red sauce "Fantabulous!" I wish the prices were a little lower. If you are in Sheepshead Bay, Randazzo's is a must.
I wish this place lived up to the hype, but it's really just an average place. I guess I don't really like seafood drowned in red sauce.

An old time Brooklyn Fav of ours. Great, steaming hot delicious chowders, surprisingly delish fried zucchini sticks, fantastic fried calamari in mild sauce and order the  muscles zuppa!!!  Say hello to Paulie Randazzo.

The steamed cherry stone clams-- holy cow!!! So fresh, tastes like the sea....so delicious with hot melted butter and lemon. I dug the sauce -- the hot marinara- served with the calamari as well. A little pricey-- and the service is just plain out rude, but I will overlook that part for the CLAMS!!!!

ITS TRAP 
Dishes sizes are like kids size unless u r willing to pay a lot of money to get ok size dish.
The taste is very normal ( nothing special) maybe even less than norma

Let me put aside my seafood bias and speak as an enthusiast .. the freshness of the seafood I just had was undoubted ..  The calamari, cunch, clams, and shrimp (combo) came with the homemade special sauce ... It was incredibly unique and yummy! I never settled for a salsa that go along with my seafood as I just did ... the portion size is small compared to what you pay here .. it also came with bread that is very hard and wet that I am still traumatized and confused why do they serve it! the service was good! I sat on the stools facing the cooks and the manager checked on me many times and refiled my salsa which they would usually charge a dollar for! In general the freshness make this place above average + the salsa = 4 stars .. Pitfall: $$-$$$, I am a fan ..

I must say this place took me by surprise. The food was amazing, fresh and tasty. Its worth coming over here, if your looking for a great meal and I thought the portions were just enough.

We ended up getting oysters, cherry stones and rigatoni in vodka sauce with chicken. I was stuffed.

Randazzo's is a neighborhood institution. It's been in Sheepshead Bay since 1932. My dad been coming here for decades and he has finally introduced me.

We split the raw clams and mussels. They're fresh and have a pristine taste. I liked them straight. My dad likes them fully loaded with lemon juice, cocktail sauce, horseradish, and Tabasco sauce. 

We also had fried calamari. This was the best fried calamari I've had. The crust was light, and I could actually taste the squid were as most calamari has the creasing overpower the squid. It was also covered in the house made medium red sauce. The sauce is delicious! It would be great on anything!

Came to Sheepshead Bay at the spur of the moment.. My bf and I yelped a few places for food.. But before we could decide we drove by Randazzo's. Clam Bar across the street from the marina. The staff at Randazzos was very friendly and helpful.. The food was delicious... I think i found my new favorite baked clams place in NY.. And the chicken parm with spaghetti was perfect.. The sauce had the perfect combination of sweet and tangy.. I would definitely come back!

This was recommended by someone who has been coming for years here. Establish in 1932 as crab shack and then in 1988 a restaurant.  They have a number system when you arrived. Men's Bathroom were clean. No music playing. But you can hear every once in a while the intercom of the kitchen staff cooking away. Great servers and waiters in this fast pace restaurant.  Seating is a little close to others, but about a seat away from each other. The also serve you water in plastic pitchers. The decor is marine images as octagon frame with sailor not and anchors made in wood. The checks are done by hand. No posts system. And yes they accept credit cards. Visa, mastercard, American express , discover and they have a atm.

Casual, but pretty tasty. Came in with a party of 8 and was surprised that they were able to accommodate us so quickly. Throughout my time here, many people came in and waited about 20 minutes or so.

The fried calamari isn't the best I've had and it is a pretty small portion, but tastes very fresh. It comes with the hardest bread you will probably ever come upon, but the waiter said your supposed to add the warm sauce on top to soften it...makes sense now. The chicken parmesan is very tasty and not a bad price. It is clearly a family business that continues to operate with family members which is very nice to see.
Coming here for years. One of the best and consistent seafood places. They have steamers which are farm raised and free of sand. You don't have to rinse them.

Looking to fulfill my seafood cravings, I headed here as I read it was a local institution. I found the seafood here mediocre. I wouldn't go out of my way to come here again, though the food was passable.

Just one of those hole in the walls where you get your bang for your buck. You really don't know this place unless you're from Brooklyn or someone from Brooklyn takes you here.

I love to always get the mussels and dip my spaghetti in the white wine sauce. Delicioso!
Ordered calamari on Memorial Day. The food portion was served on a saucer. The cost was $13.95...you must be kidding. SG

One star for delicious fresh oysters and little neck clams served with a side of lemon, cocktail sauce or horseradish. These oysters and clams prepared at the front of the store so you can taste the freshness. 
Second star for huge portions! The pasta dishes are so worth it and very flavorful. I had the seafood Randazzo which was a huge plate of pasta in garlic sauce along with a few cooked oysters, clams and shrimps. Nicely seasoned.
Third star for fried calamari. Fried calamari is perfectly seasoned, with not too much breading and not too little. It is a must have when you come here right along with the raw oysters and clams.
Fourth star for an amazing server. Our server was not only friendly, attentive and helpful but she was doing her job properly. Even though the restaurant was packed and busy, she was helpful with our orders and was very considerate. Best of yet, she was friendly and always served with a smile.

Minus one star for the wait and the inconsistent seating arrangements. The host literally told whoever to come in to just wait for an open seat and grab it. So even if you came first, if you don't bum rush to an open table, you might get stolen from someone else. Also, I did make a reservation for a large group on a Sunday but there was some mixed communication amongst the staff. So instead of compensating for that, we ended up waiting another hour and half for seats while other guest walked right now and sat in a table whenever it was free..

Came one day last week for a celebration of obtaining my bachelors degree.  Seriously let's just talk about the sauce .  I ordered the shrimp fra diavlo which had just enough heat, but the sauce with chunks of garlic..I couldn't stop eating it was so good.  Also got oysters which are always delicious.  Well worth the trip to Brooklyn, especially on a beautiful night when you can walk along the pier

A seafood restaurant! Expect to eat seafood dishes! This restaurant also has options for people who do not particularly enjoy seafood, so fear not! 
My friends came here for the raw oysters and clams, so they definitely enjoyed it. I enjoyed the calamari and mozzarella sticks. Those were so nicely battered and fried to perfection. Mozzarella sticks were stringy, cheesey, and just so good. I like how the waitress offered to bring both the mild and spicy sauce for the calamari for us, though, there was not much of a difference for me. Their portions for the pasta is large and would definitely fill you up! What I ordered was just alright though. It looked good but was not too fascinating for my taste buds. I, however, liked my friends penne alla vodka. So beautifully cooked and sauced! Yuuumm. Definitely going to try that in a future visit.
Soo... Apparently, due to miscommunication, our group's reservation was either cancelled or... Something of that sort, so we did have to wait extra for our table. I believe quite a few guests had left and they could have set up another area for us to sit, but they kept waiting for a particular area to place us, hence the longer wait time...

Love this place so much is definitely a must come back I started coming as a teenager and was hooked ever since I love their chicken parmigiana always get it. I'm coming back next time to try those shrimps they looked very tasty this place is good to celebrate a holiday especially when you have a little wait before you get a table you can walk over to the pier and see a nice view that's a plus in my book.

I call this my quick fix seafood spot with everything.  The pasta dishes are huge and enough to feed 2 to 3 people. The shucking of the oysters could be better but you get what you paid for. They usually only have one kind of oysters.  The service is quick and friendly. Parking can be a bit of a challenge since the area is packed with restaurants.
Clam chowder, calamari, and fried soft shell crab was amazing. Fries super crispy. MEAT SAUCE AMAZING. To top it off the atmosphere is very friendly along with the waitress. Will be coming back.

Good seafood place. Quick and simple menu. If you don't know what the dish is, you'll get help from the staff. While eating here I was thinking of an Italian mother and her recipes with her family. The portions are large enough to share or if you're hungry you can eat it by yourself. Would recommend to anybody who likes to eat.

The soft shell crabs were really bad. I could only taste the fried crust, but the but crab. The scallops were butchered in the same way! The waitress was one of the slowest I ever saw and had a look on her face as if I owed her lots of money. She brought me a wrong side dish - french fries instead of the (over-fried) zucchini I ordered - and had a f*** you expression on her face when I asked to change it. It's highly overpriced for the food, quality and service we got. Maybe their clams are better, but I don't think I will return...ever

Before going to Coney Island, we decided to have dinner and I wanted some good crab. This place has the best seafood .... And my hubby ordered chicken Parmesan which was also delicious. The calamari as an appetizer was also good besides the wet cold piece of bread they placed on the plate. Soda should be a bigger size it's pretty much toddler sized my hubby had to order like 5 to be a normal serving. It is very light in the place so it isn't date night atmosphere and I recommend this place if your looking to have good seafood or Italian food with someone your not embarrassed to get dirty in front of lol

The good: The service was great. The woman was very attentive. She asked us a few times if we were okay.  The oysters were good.

The not so good: tiny disposable plastic cups for water and drinks. It's an accident waiting to happen. The portions weren't big as others stated. While the calamari was tasty, the portion was for one or tops two people. The pasta with garlic and oil size was for one person. The crab cake filling was so so. The lobster roll while big, wasn't tasty and lacked lobster meat. For its price of $22, I expected lots of lobster meat.

We sat down on Friday around 7pm, and started to fill up quickly.
Over priced fish and chips was $20.00 for one small piece of fish, Mc Donald's fries are better. Service stinks

This is not the place to go for life changing fresh seafood.  Instead this is a Brooklyn institution that serves good food and hosts many great characters.  A total scene and a fun one at that.  Seafood is expensive these days.... fast service!

Some may say its overrated, but I say that they make a great calamari.

They know their seafood very well. I don't think I have ever been to any other seafood places in the area just because this place takes the cake,

p.s. they have delicious mints

What can I say??? This is my favorite food spot on the planet-- well maybe the 5 boroughs. Everything is delicious but for me the last 40 some odd years has been about the fried calamari with hot sauce or the scungilli with hot sauce. Nothing like it anywhere. It's all about the sauce.

The best!!!
Been going for well over 30 years and never had a bad meal.
Shrimp, calamari, soup, clam sauce, fried zucchini etc... All great!
I can't say enough about this place.

Calamari was very good! Cooked perfectly and fresh. Sauce was delcious and thick. The colelaw is fabulous with a kick of horseradish. Crabcakes were good. They give you two crabcakes, which was too much. Took home.

Sorry, but it was not what I expected!  

Fried calamari was pretty good.  Portion was VERY SMALL and came with a thick block of stale bread.  Not sure what that was about...

I ordered the crab cake sandwich.  2 crab cakes on a hamburger bun.  The crab cakes were thick with lots of bread crumb filling!  Way too dry!  For the high price, it would have been nice if the sandwich was on a nicer roll.  It came with a tiny, square, plastic "container" of tarter sauce, the stuff you get at a diner.  For the price I paid, it would have been nice to have a variety of sauces, like fresh tarter or some other sauce.  The coleslaw was pretty good, but the serving was extremely small!!  

Husband ordered linguine and clam sauce.  He enjoyed it!  He really wanted some bread with his pasta to soak up that clam sauce.  Bread does not come with the meal!!

Although the service was great, we both decided it is not worth a return trip!  Very overpriced!

I was taken there by friend on a trip to NY. I have never been to this side of town before however I must say I like the waterfront scene and all the restaurants and lounges along the waterfront. My friend said it reminds him of a wanna be South Beach. lol
Anyway, we went to this very casual restaurant and was seated right away. The server came to our table right away and asked in she could get us something to drink. Right away I was impress, because usually in NY, service can seem like such a bother to the staff. We order our food , or rather my friend ordered by food. We had 2 orders of the calamari for appetizers and they were delicious, or maybe i was just hungry. lol
Then he ordered our main course Lobster Fra Diavolo, OMG! when I was finish I felt like licking the bowl, the red sauce was delicious and fresh, spicy and all sorts of goodness! We usually go to Queen Italian Restaurant in downtown Brooklyn whenever I am in town but Randazzo's your my new favorite!
Clam chowder was very tasty, see food combination was ok. Nice service is also a big plus

It's a Monday night and Randazzo's, a casual neighborhood place, is pretty much packed.   Hmmm. That says one thing to me --the food must be good. Daughter in law steered me to Randazzo's and she wasn't wrong.  It's an Italian seafood joint and I was craving some shrimp. 
We were served a delicious crusty bread with butter. Just the right texture.  Reminded me of French bread.  Had the Fried zucchini appetizer served with a super tasty, marinara sauce. Yum. They did a good job of frying them so oiliness was at a minimum.  A bowl of New England clam chowder was creamy and delicious with fresh and plentiful pieces of clams. Ordered Shrimp parmigiana with spaghetti and marinara sauce, Chicken parmigiana with pasta, Crab cakes with zucchini, broiled lobster, and spaghetti with garlic and oil.  A wonderful array of dishes all prepared with great expertise except for the spaghetti with oil and garlic. It looked beautiful upon presentation with slices and slivers of garlic topping the pasta. But it lacked flavor because it basically lacked seasoning. Did our chef get so involved in making our other dishes to perfection that he forgot to put salt in the pasta water??  We brought it home and i will fix it because all that beautiful garlic cannot go to waste. 
First time at  Randazzo's won't be my last--it's a super delicious place to eat with courteous and attentive service.

Fried clams, steamed mussels and a lobster roll: what more could you ask for? While the food was good, the Randazzo sauce was heavy on the stomach, even for the "mild". We were sitting directly under a vent, which made for a cold experience and the waitstaff was odd. Very lax & odd. It's a casual setting, so you can decide on a whim to go. Glad I finally made my way to try it, but I didn't leave with a "wow" reaction.

One of the Best calamari we ve had in Brooklyn.The place is very old school with so much character.Its rare to still find places like this .hope it's still here for years to come as we will definitely be back

A few friends and I made plans to try out Randazzo's for steamers and a late lunch this past Sunday. When we got to the casual restaurant, we were dismayed when the waitress informed us that they didn't have any steamers that day. However, the famous red sauce made up for this disappointment.

But let's back up to the beginning of the meal. The menu has a decent amount of choices, from seafood to Italian specialties. While mozzarella sticks are so tempting to eat by the beach (my first time trying mozzarella sticks was on the beachfront deck at Martell's in Point Pleasant Beach, NJ in the early 90's), we opted instead for the calamari with red sauce, and some baked clams. The calamari was good, not too chewy, and we preferred the red sauce on the side instead of smothered on top. The baked clams were good too, somewhat standard, but good.

For my main course, I had seen photos on yelp of the rigatoni vodka, and knew I must have it. I am so glad I did, because it was so garlicky, so creamy, had such a nice depth of flavor, that I had no order envy of the various gigantic seafood + red sauce + linguine plates that sat menacingly in front of my friends. From the $5 mini bottles of house white, to the slightly surly and perfunctory manner of the waitress, I really liked the old New York style of Randazzo's. And of course, the sauce.

We definitely enjoyed our meal here.  Started off with the baked clams appetizer (little necks) which were coked just right.  Not over done and properly seasoned.  Pure heaven.  Then my partner had the linguine with clams (white sauce) and I had the fried oyster sandwich with a baked potato.  They did not skimp on the fried oysters.  There were so many oysters they were falling out of the sandwich!  And it was delicious.  My partner seemed to enjoy his dish since he was drinking the sauce after devouring the pasta LOL.  Will definitely check it out again since there are a lot of other things on the menu that I want to try!

Fresh and delicious seafood!!!!! Great service, our waitress was a gem and such a joy to be around! I would absolutely visit this place again....I had the pleasure of ordering the fried shrimp and steak fries...super yummy and the shrimps were HUGE, FRESH and TASTY!!!! Kudos for making my Friday night LIVE and for seating us immediately although we thought the place was packed so we may have to wait, not the case here we were seated on time and our food arrived hot, steamy and on time

If fried seafood goodness is what you're craving, this is the place to go. The bisque and chowders are all solid too. Got to get the gallamah, my favorite place that does it. You'll be a little surprised it's as pricey as it is based on the context of the restaurant. But it's good stuff.

Unassuming looks from the outside, but the seafood quality here blows away all preconceived notions from looks alone. As someone who knew nothing about Randazzo's until after the fact, I walked in with mildly low expectations. I had the NE clam chowder. Nothing to write home about but good. For the entree I ordered the crab cakes. Best crab cakes. Ever. Better than crab cakes I've had in Maryland (granted those are blue crabs vs Dungeness they use here). You can actually taste and really see the enormous chunks of crab meat. Do yourself a favor and go here. Other seafood entrees are huge and well prepared.

I came here for lunch because I work two blocks away and I was in the mood for Italian, my friend had wanted to try their lobster roll after seeing another table order it the last time he was here I read up on this place on yelp and ordered calimari $12 and we shared a pasta the shrimp with spicy red sauce I forgot the exact name of it.. It was $23. 

My thoughts on this place is the food is below average the service is slow and the only thing worth giving a star about is the nice waitress who always served us with a smile and the marinara sauce. If you have a short lunch break like I do, I would not suggest coming here ...the food took forever to come out, I was not a fan of the "shrimp foh sth pasta " and I thought the lobster roll was a joke, the bread is not toasted or buttered, the lobster lacked flavor and there wasn't really an abundance of lobster meat compared to the size of the roll I would suggest red hook lobster over this place or by far the best I've had in nyc is lobster joint In queens. 

One star went to the calimari Only because the marinara sauce that comes with it was bomb diggity, the calimari itself is ehh .. L&B serves better and a bigger portion for same price *if you do order the calimari I suggest getting the sauce on the calimari because you get more sauce that way and that's really the only thing worth eating.

If you love seafood and amazing customer service Randazzo's should definitely be on your "to-do" list. I haven't experienced too much of Sheepshead Bay but apparently Emmons Avenue is the place to be in the summer. My boyfriend and I love seafood so we decided to have dinner at Randazzo's on a Sunday afternoon. 

My boyfriend informed me before stepping inside the restaurant that it was a very casual environment. Upon stepping inside it is definitely casual ambiance with harsh lighting, absolutely nothing to write home about. So we opted to sit outside which we usually do anywhere that has outside seating. The outside seating is along the side of the restaurant and offered a great opportunity to people watch and view JFK air traffic. 

The host brought over a pitcher of ice water which was super refreshing on a Sunday afternoon. After a very short wait we were greeted by our server. She was incredibly friendly and made us feel like she'd do anything to make us satisfied. After reviewing their very extensive menu we were finally ready to make some decisions. We ordered the fried calamari and baked clams for appetizers. They both were super fresh and delicious. I also ordered the lobster roll with fried zucchini. The lobster roll was very meaty and simply fantastic. The side of fried zucchini was a very large portion size. I couldn't even finish it all. Finally, even the cole slaw was tasty. Most places miss the boat when it comes to cole slaw but this was the kind of slaw you could eat all day. 

Overall, we really enjoy our Randazzo's experience and will definitely be back!
Best place ever! it's all about the medium sauce! I loved the stuffed shrimp!
Place is more of a name than anything else... Fried calamari was good not great... Linguini w clam sauce was tasteless and the burnt chicken was just ok...

It's been almost twelve years since I've lived in Brooklyn and every year that I come home to visit there's always that one place a friend will suggest to eat that will make me remember "oh yea, I hated this place."  It's basically Russian roulette for your digestive system every time I hear "we should do dinner," but not wanting to be that one friend who says "oh but...." I say a little prayer and hope that this isn't the place that does me in....  Friends, enemies, and strangers reading this and hoping I'm not about to tell you about Montezuma's revenge....I'm here to tell you, Randazzo's was not that place.  

Overwhelmed by our options, my girlfriend and I decided to share the Lobster Roll and Soft Shell Crab Sandwich with the fried zucchini as our side.  This was no regular Lobster Roll let me tell you.  This thing was ginormous and could very easily feed two people.  The lobster in the sandwich was generously sized and there was a good ratio of lobster per bite unlike other places where they overload the roll with celery and other fillers.  The softshell crab was fried to perfection and wasn't overly breaded allowing the taste of the crab to shine through each bite.  Even the fried zucchini was on point.

Randazzo's is a neighborhood institution and growing up here, I know why, but it's nice to come home after twelve years and have the taste buds sing rather than my stomach yell at me for treason.  If you're traveling and reading this I promise you won't regret eating here.  If you live here and read this, I promise I'm not some random chick from Honolulu who doesn't know her food writing up a review about a Brooklyn institution.  I know my food; I didn't get fluffy from eating celery.  

In closing, eat here.  It's good.

Lived near Sheepshead bay my whole life used to love this place as a kid and teen but now if you go it's very different the food is not a good as it once was..plus It's super overpriced for small portions..the lobster bisque is the worst i have ever had don't order unless you like the taste of  Campbell's Chunky soups... Very disappointing
My 1st time to try soft shell crab, it's fun but the taste is not as attractive. the original flavour of crab is gone.

Put simply, they make the best spicey tomato sauce on the planet.  Lobster bisque and crab cakes are delicious too.  Pull up a stool at the clam bar and enjoy Emelio's company.  He's worked there forever and makes the experience a delight.

Randazzo's Clam bar is absolutely my favorite place to eat, which is unfortunate because I live in Baltimore. My Dad went to this place all the time in the 70's and he says the sauce and the food is just as delicious today as it was then. 

EVERY time I go to NY I stop here, no matter how far out of the way it is. You just can't get food like this anywhere else. I highly recommend the baked clams and the Calamari. 

The sauce that they have is a very old recipe that has been passed down for generations, and it is absolutely to die for. You can choose between MEDIUM and SPICY, and you can get containers to go, which I always do if my Dad isn't with me so I can bring some home to him. 

The staff is extremely friendly, attentive, and down to earth. GO HERE!

EVERYTHING is good. Everything. I could drink their red sauce. The clams and fish are SO fresh. Service is great and fast despite the fact that it is almost always packed. Arrive at least 40 minutes before you intend on taking a seat as there is always a line but that is an indicator of great...everything.

Decided to try it out. If you like diners and seafood, this is it.  Personally not a fan, but the food is delicious but overpriced in my opinion. Their combo plate is twenty-something $$ and is a portion of a 10$ appetizer. The food is already pre-made, so as soon as you order, your plate is ready to go.  Customer service is great!

Unique, quaint sort of place with a history that seems more delightful to read about than to experience -- even though it was indeed a delicious meal. We were a party of six that ordered a variety of stuff from the menu - talapia, fried calamari, stuffed lobster, lobster, salads, and a combo. The prices don't really match the decor and location, but I guess they do match the quality of the food. I'd go for a pasta next time.

Great food grate service staff really knows how to make you feel welcome here and there is never a day that you go and the food is off they are consistent literally no better place to go have seafood in Brooklyn

First off let me start by saying the staff is great here. Always friendly and cheerful, we love Emilio!!! Now to the food, omg so good. Fresh seafood and always tasty. I have yet to try a plate and not like it. Stuffed shrimp is delicious and friend calamari is always crispy. One of my favorite seafood restaurants.

I've driven by Randazzo's Clam Bar countless times on the way to Roll-N-Roaster but never really gave it a try. My friends dined here before and recommended it. We gave it a try and the outcome was meh.  We arrived on a Sunday evening and there were plenty of tables open.

The decor is disappointing and old school. A renovation is long overdue--and what's the deal with those 4 oz. plastic cups?? What happened to cups for adults??

Steamers $23.95 - Their steamers were hot, fresh, and large. But there was 1 big flaw. SAND. There was sand in every bite and sand all over my plate.

Rigatoni w/ Vodka Sauce w/ Shrimp $23.95 - The restaurant should really put this pasta in the alcoholic beverages section because our pasta tasted like cheap vodka! It's not every often people get drunk off pasta, but Randazzo's sure knows how to pack a punch with every bite. We notified our waitress immediately and she let the chef know about his heavy hand. 

Lobster Roll $21.95 - I shared this plate with my fiancé. The lobster roll is large enough for 2. No complaints of the taste here. I'd recommend this roll.

Lobster Bisque Bowl/Spicy Crab Corn Chowder Bowl $9.00 - Both soups were a solid choice. The bisque was creamy and filling with a tiny portion of lobster. I tried the spicy crab chowder and it was spicy and tasty.

Randazzo's Clam Bar is a pricey for what you get. It was nothing out of this world and I'll be unlikely to come back.
Very homey. Calamari is the best,  I always say a little bit crispy with medium sauce. Out of this world. It's more of a mom and pop type of place but I enjoy it from time to time
Love this place eat here all the time ! Best see food in town , you can have here fresh oysters and all kind of other see products .

I was craving seafood on this particular day and decided to come here for some clams. I was greeted immediately at the door and was seated right away. The restaurant appeared clean as well as the men's room. 

I started with the mozzarella sticks as an appetizer. The sticks were well seasoned and the marinara sauce was really good. I ordered the Zuppa Di Clams in a white wine sauce as my entrée. Man, those things were spectacular! I had some bread to soak up the sauce and man, it was delicious. 

My server waitress was friendly as well as professional. She catered to my needs and checked on me occasionally to make sure I was good. 

This place can be a little pricey but I think the food justifies the price. I will definitely return in the near future because I want to try out their king crab legs!
amazing .. Authentic .... They keep it so real and tell you the price of the lobster tail before ordering lol ....

Randazzo's is a no frills restaurant with a simple menu. It's loud with a lot of yelling all around. However, its not about the noise level. It's about that unbelievably good red sauce that accompanies every order of calamari and also an option as a sauce for spaghetti or linguini. The calamari (calamah) is tender and the breading is light. The steamers we ordered were ok, but I was hoping for a stronger flavor in the broth. Ive had better steamers from them before. The lobster bisque was thick and hearty, as was the New England clam chowder. I ordered 2 full orders of linguini with the medium sauce so we had a double helping of the red sauce on the pasta and with the 2 orders of calamari. I would most definitely come back for that sauce. I do wonder if they will sell the sauce separately so it's something I will ask the next time we trek it out to Sheepshead Bay.

Great tasting and very fresh steamers at brooklyn. Don't expert too much from this place but for the price, it is worth visiting. I like their hot marinara sauce. Truly flavorful compared to other Italian restaurant. Good family restaurant. Bright and spacious. Nice service. 
Ordered:
Steamers 
Fried calamari 
Chicken parmesan with spaghetti

Con: not much wine section.  

Overall: 2.5
I always go here for their oysters and clam chowder! The seafood is fresh and delicious! It doesnt look too fancy but it is tasty!

I have been a few times and I love how casual the place is but how delicious their food is, especially the red sauce. If you ever visit this place, make sure to try their red sauce, it is to die for! Their sea food is always fresh and cooked perfectly. Service is good, the waiters and waitresses are always so nice and kind. Just a great spot for delicious sea food!
Beautiful location. Amazing food, friendly staff. We had both the shrimp and lobster randazzo with spaghetti and it was heaven.

Ate here today and holy shit!  Unbelievable!   So good!  Great place!  Staff properly trained and on point!  Fellow owner has got his shit together.  Way better experience than my last trip to Nassau county!  Must check it out!  Awesome place

It took me a week to make this review Bc I really hate writing bad reviews! The service was horrible! They were aggravated to have to serve us! We ordered lobster bisque banked clams and muscles!!! We both got soooo sick!!!! We barley made it back to Staten Island! We only had water and club soda to drink so I can't even blame it on drinking! The bread they gave us was extremely stale I asked for different bread for the lobster bisque and they gave me a package of broken crackers ! I won't be returning! I have been here a few times and liked it but this establishment has gone down hill! I'm sorry to have to give it a bad review but it deserved it!

I loved their flavorful creamy New England clam chowder and their zucchini fries was light and crispy!Their waiters was very friendly and attentive with making sure we had another pitcher of water when they notice we just finished it and take away our plates for us to have more space for comfort and always making sure everything is okay by asking. Customer service is so important and they definitely have a great staff!

My favorite seafood place in brooklyn. Every time I am home, my father knows exactly where I want to eat. This place is family owned and the owner knows every customer that walks in the door. It has a great staff, the food is freshly made, and the environment is low-key and comfortable. 

The stuffed shrimp is my go-to! Nice and hot, juicy, and not drenched in butter. This is, hands-down, my favorite dish. I always go with the fried zucchini - it's just so darn good.

My dad and sister always get the lobster with the red sauce.

This has been a family location for us since I was a little girl! I highly recommend this place. If you want Brooklyn seafood, stop in at Randazzo's.

Wow I must say they really changed, they have new younger staff servers who actually like their job an like customers. Lol 
We visited over the weekend an had a great experience, great food as always their food is always amazing. 
They Still have the big ol water pitcher an small plastic cups. Which again I'm not a huge fan of the pitcher it just never will sit right with me. 
OMG no more mints the son said the company discontinued them :( wah they where so yummy.


Parking in the back of the restaurant an there's always a small wait to be seated.

$$$ pricey but worth it.

Let me begin by saying 'It's all in the sauce' !!. I've been coming here for the past 32 years and it's always a gastronomic experience. It's becomes a bit pricey but it's all worth it for sure!...Starting from my succulent fresh shucked clams and oysters deliciously arranged on a plate momentarily because I eat them as fast as they come,  and a side bowl of  New England Clam chowder, it's the best in Brooklyn..... I methodically move on to the Fried Shrimp with Randazzo's famous Sauce....OMG it is to die for with the big hard biscuits ( always a topic of conversation), that were born to be dipped in this river of goodness. get the spicy sauce and get it on everything as for the shrimp, ooooh, the shrimp. freshly fried but not tasting fried, there is no breading or heavy coating to weigh down or cover the taste just big ole shrimp and that sauce!!!!....Now it's time for a tummy check for sure.....always the same time during my meal.... the turning point...You know, the point where you know damn well you are full but you didn't have your Calama,  translated the best Fried Calamari on the planet...yes....with the sauce! but honestly, it's so good by itself that you do not need the sauce, but you want more sauce and more sauce.....God the sauce........Now, I must say that the above is my usual ritual add a short bottle of Pepsi plus the traditional randazzo pitcher of water in the soft plastic cup (classic old-school). I have at times adjusted my menu to start with the Fried Shrimp and Calamari with THE Sauce, and then had a real entree like the Linguini with the billion clam sauce or the Chicken Francese which I dare you to finish the whole thing.....but ....you get the idea.

Not my favorite seafood place but I do enjoy coming here once in a while. The decor isn't so nice but the staff is pretty friendly and I never had an issue with the service. Their clam chowder is ok but I love their baked stuffed clams which is my favorite thing to get here. Wouldn't go out of my way to come here but if I'm in the area, I will continue stopping by.

If yr a fan a seafood come here cause it doesn't get any better (or pricier jk) than here. Hey everything is great and on point,, loved the shrimp pasta and got some soup on the side and left a satisfied and happy man.

I have driven by a thousand times. Looks like a perfect old school Brooklyn joint. Popped in with my son, figured we'd grab a quick sandwich and come back for dinner with my hubby some time. Really disappointing. Ordered a fried fish Sandwich. It came, two big pieces of long fried fish on a plain small round bun and fries. 20 dollars?!! It literally had no taste. I squeezed lemon all over it salt, still, NO TASTE. They give you marinara on the side so we figured OK, maybe they know something we don't. Poured it on the bun. Nope, just not good. Did I mention $20 for A SANDWICH?! The entire menu was insanely expensive for what you could mostly get a Rocco's Calamari for literally half the price if not less.

Food and service were both great. I came with a party of 5 on a Saturday night and they were able to seat us within 10 minutes. The red sauce is amazing and I found myself dipping everything in it. Will definitely be back.

This place is a $$ rated business, so first and foremost, if your going to give Randazzo's a low rating strictly based on the price of the food, you shouldn't be writing reviews. I get it, it ain't cheap, but it's worth it. 
Personable owner, friendly staff and great food. This spot values its customers and it was refreshing to come to a restaurant that gave you a neighborhood feel.
Had the calamari, baked clams, and shrimp fra diavolo. Everything was awesome (I enjoy stuffing my fat face).
If you want quality food with great service go to Randazzo's.
The Lobster Bisque in this place is superior and unique way over any other restaurant in the world. I believe that this restaurant is the top rated seafood place in the world.
We have been coming here for some time now. If you truly want to enjoy the seafood, try it broiled, grilled or in sauce...the best.
I really dont see what a the hype is about unless I ordered the wrong meal.The staff is very friendly and helpful.The place is clean and the size portikns of food are decent.

I've been here a couple of times in the past and the service and food is always unbelievable. Although this is a very fast pace restaurant the staff always seem to make time to provide great customer service. 

As For the food: the baked clams are AMAZING as is everything else!
Extremely overpriced! Tiny portions of very average food. Cannot believe the hype. Very disappointing.
After all these years, never changed.  Still tastes the same.  Delicious and worth every cent.  Lucky that they are still around after everything else on that block changed.

I wish I came to eat at this place earlier. Nonetheless, the food & service was excellent. My husband & I ordered to share: 1) Cup of Lobster Bisque Soup, 2) Calamari, 3) Baked Clams, 4) Dozen of raw oysters, and 5) Shrimp & Lobster Linguine w/ Red Sauce.

Lobster Bisque Soup - It was delicious! It tasted better when you throw in the oyster cracker - delish!

Calamari - This is a must order! It was so delicious with their special red sauce. The calamari here is so superb, probably one of the best calamari that I had so far.

Baked Clams - It was ok. I didn't find the baked clams here special.

Raw Oysters - The oysters were briny and small. It was not the best oysters I had. I wouldn't order it again.

Shrimp & Lobster Linguine w/ Red Sauce - This is another must order! It was super delicious! Pasta was al dente, w/ lots of pieces of shrimp & lobster. And that red sauce is CRACK! Actually anything with their red sauce is delicious! 

Highly recommend their calamari & pasta! Wish they would sell a jar of their red sauce - so damn good!

My husband and I Found this hidden treasure on Yelp and it was definitely worth the 30min drive.. I absolutely loved it!! Service was at 5 stars, friendly and fast. The food was delicious and fresh.. We ordered the fried calamari it was great! Crispy not rubbery, the little neck clams were fresh. My husband ordered the soft shell crab sandwich and he can't stop talking about how great it was.. Shrimp randazzo is a must.. Will definitely recommend this restaurant.

The food here is great, the service is great, and the place itself is great. My parents were the first ones to come here and after that we made it our Sunday family dinner place. I'm not a big seafood lover but the dishes are delicious. A definitely hidden treasure.

I have been going to Randazzos for forty years for clams. They are always fresh and ice cold.  I also get the calamari steamed with hot sauce.  Generally good.   
The place is dated and loud.  There were six customers and three waitresses siting down in the back.   I had to get up and walk back three times to get her attention.   My son asked if anyone turned in sun glasses; out waitress yelled to Emil across the floor to ask him.   Wow!!!  What tact and elegance.   Did I mention the clams are the freshest and ice cold. 
The grilled octopus is 30 bucks.   I had better at a Greek restaurant on Cross Bay for  $20.   The pasta comes in pre-cooked and they refused to cook some fresh.   I asked for a glass for my five dollar beer and they offered a four ounce plastic cup.  How professional!   She did say she could get me a wine glass.
I give it two stars for the fresh clams and the sauce.   The place is overpriced.

It's a Saturday afternoon, and we're randomly in Sheepshead Bay without a single clue what we are going to eat.  So we walked down Emmons Ave, and came upon Randazzo's, a rather small and unassuming spot from the outside.  Inside, the space opens up some.  Nonetheless, their signage caught my eye as they claim to be the neighborhood's beloved hot spot.  In we went.  

The first impression I got when we walked in was that we were welcome there, just like you would be at home.  You are practically sitting on the water at Randazzo's.  The only better view is dining on a boat itself.  That said, this really isn't where you take someone on a romantic date, this is where you gather you closest friends and gather 'round at the neighborhood joint because that's tradition, and it is a guaranteed good time.  Throughout the 1.5 hours we were there, we saw a steady incoming and outgoing flux of customers.  Everyone seemed to be a regular - knowing exactly what they wanted without so much consulting the menu (I heard clam chowder ordered more than 3x so I would say that this is probably one of their specialties).  

We ordered the Stuffed Shrimp and an order of Grilled Chicken Cutlet (for my bbgirl who is very sensitive to seafood).  The stuffed shrimp is uh-may-zing.  Upon first bite, I was completely blown out of the waters.  Jumbo shrimp stuffed with a hearty filling that contained smaller-sized shrimps sitting atop some sort of sauce that I was lapping up with my spoon.  This is normally not acceptable etiquette, but it's a crime to leave sauce this good sitting there!  The price for this dish was quite steep at $25 (when taking portion into consideration as well), but if you're treating yourself (or someone), it is so worth it.  For non-seafood lovers, the grilled chicken cutlet was also quite good.  My daughter ate quite a bit of it (as much as a 14month old can anyway).  The chicken was seasoned before it was slapped on a grill. Oh, and get their zucchini fries.  That stuff was delish!  

No experience is without a consideration of server-customer interaction, and these guys know how to make you feel at home.  The cashier, server, and even owner himself, came by to say hello.  It really put the perfect touch in rounding out the entire experience.  

Needless to say, we'll definitely be coming back.

It is all about the sauce at this classic Brooklyn clam bar. On a beautiful day- it doesn't get any better than Randazzo's "on the Bay."
Ate:
Manhattan clam chowder
Little necks
Shrimp fra diavolo
I've been on a Manhattan clam chowder quest & this is a good one. Better still are those freshly shucked clams served with some local attitude on the side, the sauce on the far diavolo was bright spicy & sensational w/ slivers of fresh garlic. I love their twice baked bread with the fried calamari even though I didn't get it this time. Nostalgic, red sauce, Brooklyn clam bar heaven.

Decent. I've always had fresh calamari and decent pasta but only because I worked in the area and frequented often. It's not a date night place but a solid family atmosphere. Bring the kids. It gets noisy but it's to be expected. Don't go out of your way to get here but if in the area, stop in for a quick bite.

Came in today for dinner, 4 adults and 2 children. In a nut shell.... The food was mediocre. Nothing special.  Their prices are on the high side so be aware of that. We ordered calamari which was the smallest plate I have ever seen for $15! 
The staff was friendly which is good. 

My main issue was with the bathroom. There was no changing table to change my newborns diaper. I had a changing pad with me and had to put in on top of the garbage bin and put my baby on top because there was no place to put her. She almost fell on the floor which is unacceptable.  I saw a mother go to the bathroom with her baby too so I know she must've had an issue as well.

This establishment has been around for some time and with their high prices they should invest in a changing table before a child gets hurt.
