Beautiful piece of real estate but that's all I was able to experience. I was not sure if I was being discriminated against when I was asked if my total was alright for me to pay? But if that's not clear enough Pauly sure did confirm his agenda when I brought back the order that he clearly admitted to messing up. So instead of owning his mistake he told me and I quote "I can't give you your money back because you took it home and you touched it, I can not resell this". "you just don't want to pay for the food", "you just don't want to honor your payment". If you don't already know you can not and should not resell any food that has left the restaurant how disgusting. Many other comments were made by the manager, but I just thought I'd share part of my experience. I would not recommend this business to anyone.

We were going here quite often because we loved the taste of the food and the seating area outside. The people that work there were friendly and the manager always comes to the tables to see if everybody's doing OK. BUT in recent years the prices have gone up drastically and the portions are really small. They give you the smallest size Coca-Cola and charge full size price for it!. Me and a friend got a bill for close to $100 and we really didn't order that much! The prices went up ridiculously! Come on-this is not a five-star restaurant where you are required to wear jackets! Yes it is on the bay and checks all the boxes if you want to have a nice time but the raising prices is going to make me think twice before I come back. I'll go to Friday's and get similar service and a better view, more food and pay half the price. Sorry about that guys. Lower your prices or increase the portions of food and I'll be back.
Best seafood around. The little necks couldnt be more fresh every time and the combo platter with the hot sauce is delicious. I make the trip from the Bronx in traffic once or twice a month for it

Been going to Randazzo's Clam Bar my whole life. Best calamari, best clam chowder, and best raw clams I have had in all of NYC (from what I have had of course). Also recommend their pasta with lobster sauce.

Cons: Service can be spotty, not the most nicest restaurant ambiance (plastic cups, dated restaurant and bathrooms). Thus I can't give this place 5 stars.

Definitely worth trying though especially if you want a throwback old school Italian seafood joint in Brooklyn.

Haven't been to Randazzos since 1960's and have to say, I forgot the true meaning of a Clam Bar. Not only the reflections of the NY Haughty Ambiance, was the flavor of a sauce and quality of (Invertebrate) Seafood. The other amazing part was the friendliness of a female server, that had NY charm, coupled with an unusual Brooklyn happy and friendly demeanor. The owner himself, showed up as the 5th generation owner in his family and quickly pointed out his son opening clams. This is old Brooklyn Italian and is a must visit in Sheepshead Bay Brooklyn. Skip Lundys, its not as much as a Brooklyn experience as is Randazzos. Im Old Brooklyn Grandma fed Italian. I know.
I love this place! The lobster bisque soup was delicious! The baked clams, chicken parmigiana and fried calamari are unbeatable.

Service was good but some of what we ordered was pretty bland. Nice environment and nice staff. Wouldn't mind giving this place another shot I know other things on the menu may have been better than what we ordered today. Prices are pretty expensive and aren't worth it , just going by quality and taste.

Two words to describe my experience would be highly disappointed. 

I went with friends on a Friday night. The place was packed and the hostess asked if we wanted to sit outside or inside. Since it was a nice night we decided to sit outside. That was a huge mistake. 

The restaurant keeps its trash cans outside so there was a horrible stench. When the food came out it came in TO GO CONTAINERS. I thought this was a joke at first but I was wrong. (Picture below). 

I got Penne Vodka, which was $19.95, and it comes in a plastic to go container. No words can describe my shock. To top it all off, the pasta was bathed in oily sauce. 

Side not: The waitresses were very cold and rude. 2 even got into a huge argument with one of the tables near us. Huge spectacle. 

Long story short, I would NOT recommend this place to anyone. Your money is well spent at countless other places.

So yummy! I always get the clams with linguine over white sauce. My husband got the fried scallop sandwich which he said was good. The prices are however are killers $18.95 each!! And it's not like they give you an over sized portion so you can take it home. The portion size is just right but price is a bit of a dent in the budget for sure.

Randazzo's is a classic institution! Their calamari and sauce is such a highlight - you definitely need to order this every time you come. Steams and oysters are fresh and delicious. This place is iconic old New York. I could also eat their red sauce on a foot and be happy!

This is a Sheepshead Bay landmark restaurant. I have been coming here for decades.  I love their chowder, steamed mussels, raw oysters and clams. 
The medium red sauce is thick & savoy.
The quality of the seafood is high, but will vary seasonally.
Clams on the half-shell, steamers, oysters, pasta.. You can't go wrong here. Enjoy a steamy bowl of clam chowder, the best in town.
The prices are on the high side, and the  little plastic water cups, that tip over when you fill them are not nice.  Also, the outdoor seating and service should be avoided.  I hate frozen french fries, here or anywhere.
But if you enjoy great seafood and don't mind the prices, this is a place you will come back to again and again.  You can sit at the counter and just get a bowl of red, or delicious calamari.
I just might do that this afternoon!
I just love their fried calamari & seafood. Took a friend there & we had a good time. Waitress wad nice.

The best seafood in the area. Great selection of dishes. Prices are fair and service good. Seafood quality is good also. Fresh high quality seafood. Calamary is great, combo platter is awesome, New England chowder, and past marichiara is wow. Portions are reasonably large.

Haven't been to Randazzo's in over a year. Went with my 2 sons for lunch because we wanted steamers. Ordered fried calamari, clams on half shell, steamers and shrimp parmigiana. Everything was delicious  except for the steamers which were disappointing since they were small and looked shriveled. Very disappointing since it's been a year since I last ate them. If I was alone I would've sent them back to kitchen.

First time here--thought it would be amazing.  Mussels were very good.    Large grilled shrimp were tasty, but drowned in butter and only a choice of  potato or fries?  How about for $28 for 4 shrimp, throw in some pasta?  Other people at the table ordered the crabcakes--these were a waste of money.  Dry, heavy, dark crust was all you tasted.  Guess we should have ordered the pasta dishes--these looked very good.  Avoid the $19 crabcakes!

Oh.

Oh man,

Oh the garlic sauce. Just. Yea. Amazing.

What a fantastic place to eat. Randazzo's is not a fancy establishment, but the food is some of the best around. They have a slogan that "fresh seafood is expensive" and it is - but totally worth it!

I ordered the shrimp randazzo, 7 shrimps, 2 mussels, and 1 clam over linguine. The garlic sauce was so damn good that I sopped up every drop with bread. How good was the bread? I don't know! Who cares the sauce was amazing! The dish was $24 at the time, a price I would gladly pay again.

They sell sauce to take home with you, but only the red sauce! You gotta come back for the good stuff. They also sell a mix of beer bottles to have with your meal, nothing crazy but a decent mix.

I would love to come here again!

Over priced and bad service 
dumb waitress puts a cold beer and a hot plate of pasta in front of my 8 month old baby.... 
HELLO... What was she thinking . would not go back their , so many other places in brooklyn to eat

My very first time here and all I can say is the food is amazing! Great customer service, will definitely stop by here on my next visit. Love the oysters, lobster tail (huge size), calamari, pasta seafood, king crab and 
fried zucchini. We all had a good time celebrating love and marriage of two of our dear friends.

I WISH I could give this place NO stars. Garbage service, garbage restaurant. We went in on a Friday at 11:30pm they close at 12 it was my mom, my bf and I. We asked one of the waitors can we still eat he said yes of course, so we proceeded to sit down and look over the menu. MIND YOU there was still another table eating and ordering. The waitress came and said to us "Are you ready to order the kitchen is closing in 5 min" um she didn't give us 3 minutes to choose. We quickly chose fried calamari, fried crab legs with fries and two clam chowders. We ordered our drinks and she came and threw it at us, the food didn't take 10 minutes to prepare and also threw it like if we were begging for food. We had to eat super quick because they were putting up all the tables around us. While we were eating the waitress has the nerve to ask us. "I am sorry to interrupt but I need the check paid because the cashier is closing". My mom had to STOP eating to give her the money. I told the waitress "If you guys would of been rushing us and with bad service because you are closing you should of told us it was too late". She responded with "No you can stay here as long as you want". I just continued eating the bland, cold, soggy food. I have never regretted leaving 5 tip to someone more than this restaurant and waitress. She needs to learn some basic manners and education aside from learning how to be a PROPER WAITRESS. As for the food, especially seafood they just gave my bf more fried battered than actually crab meat. Despicable. I will NEVER EVER come here again. I wouldn't be surprised if they shut down.

Worst seafood I ever had in my life. Nothing was seasoned and everything was bland and overpriced. Four pieces of shrimp with fries for 20$. I would understand if the food was actually good but it wasn't. The pasta also didn't have any taste highly disappointed and wont be returning. Pictures look good but trust it isn't.

Randazzo always been my favorite seafood restaurant,  this time that we're here with my family is the down right worst service that we had. We sat there for 15 minutes,  no waitress or busboys come by, when we asked he told me my waitress is not here yet. Finally a waitress come by like half sleep,  of course screw up my orders. Even we asked to change our plates, they're full of shells, the bus boy only took the shell bowl on the table and walk away. Obviously we're disturbed their group chat.after all that I still tipped them 20%, I don't want the servers split on my food, because I like the food too much here.
Hopefully next time we'll get better service.

Ive been coming here for 35 years and its always been consistently good . The food is good there raw bar has always been fresh . The service is ok . The staff makes you feel like there doing you a favor when it gets busy there . That's also what makes this place unique . There aren't too many places like Randazzos left in Brooklyn so I guess you take the good with a little bad , as long as there food is good which it is

Just had dinner there. Their very over priced. We were very disappointed. Raw clams weren't that good. Ordered the soft shell crab it was so small. My husband ordered calamari with sauce on the side and the sauce was horrible. Our waitress took our appetizer order and were we're ready to order or main course. She totally forgot to come back or to ask if we're were ready to order.
Forgetting half of my order ! Never coming back here.Food was so and so ,not super tasty,next time hire more competent people

I think it's time to introduce zero star rating....
The place is a mess. My husband remembered this place as a small place with nice food. God, has everything changed. To begin with, the floor is a mess, food is all over. Second, they have plastic glasses, I was given one for water and my husband was given one for his beer. Third, EVERYTHING was over cooked. Steemed lobsters were rubbery and very small, as well as shrimps, as well as pasta and fried zucchini. For meal of fried calamari, a cup of clam chowder, lobster with zucchini on side, lobster with clams and shrimp over pasta, water and beer we paid 121.77$! The couple at the table next to us was charged extra 20$ for something they did not order and we had extra 5$ charge for something we did not have. 
I do have to say, fried calamari, water and beer were ok.
I am very disappointed, would not recommend this place to anyone.

Excellent seafood on the bay. Ordered a combo with hot tomato sauce. That came with Calamari, Shrimp, Mussels, Fried Clams, and Scungilli (snail). The sauce was incredible. Also we got steamers, which were good, although pricey at market price. The whole meal was $60 with tip for two. Service was alright, nice and local. However this was at 3pm, I'd imagine it's much slower at dinner time

Actually I would give 3.5 star. We went there on a Sunday night. Fortunately we only have waited 20 mins to get a table. Staff are respectful and helpful but Dishes are tasting fine not like other reviewers said.... We ordered spaghetti, a bowl of New England Clam Chowder, Lobster fra Diavolo, and fresh clams. Kind of disappointed with the Lobster Fra Diavolo that costs $55 tasting weird anyway. But we all agree that they have made a great Calm Chowder Soup. Maybe we will try to order something else there to see if it feels better.

My complaint is not about the food. The food is delicious and I've been here multiple times. I am DISGUSTED with one of the waitresses who works here. She has NO respect at all for customers and she's so rude. I've never experienced such inappropriate and unprofessional behavior in my life. She made my experience here horrible and she would be the top reason for me to never come back. Words can't explain how disappointed I am because this establishment truly does have great seafood. In the future, make sure you hire people who will make your customers want to come back rather than push them away....
Not good anymore! Overpriced! There are old school farters italian. Food not tast perfect. Service medium.. Get them out! Turkish cafe is better!

Awesome spot.  I felt a little rushed by the waitress.  Food was excellents. Raw clams were fresh and very meaty.  My lobster Fra Diavolo was so excellent.  I can see why they sell their sauce.  Sauce was amazing.

Its an ok place. Our waitress was older and moved kinda slow. The food was not as good as i was hoping. Ordered the combo appetizer and was disappointed on how small the serving was. Also had the alaskan king crab legs and they were pretty tasty......and pricy. Didnt care at all for the spicy (wasnt even a lil spicy) corn and crab soup. Be careful with market price....that means expensive. Needless to say we wont be back.

Randazzo's has been around for as long as I can remember. For some reason I always passed it by. Maybe it's just the drab looking exterior and interior decor. 
Tonight however I was in the mood for some fresh seafood at a Brooklyn landmark so Randazzo's is where I landed. We entered and were able to choose our own seats. Then our friendly waitress explained some of the specials.
I tried the clam chowder:  hot, fresh crab, creamy, and very flavorful. It was full of fresh clams and potatoes. My friend ordered the lobster bisque and enjoyed it very much as well. For the main course I ordered the broiled lobster. Our friendly waitress came out with a bib, and tied it on for me! We had an extensive wait for our food. However, when it was finally ready, it was worth the long wait.  My broiled lobster was  filleted open and roasted with butter. It was served with baked potato which I enjoyed as well. My friend had the roasted octopus. I tasted it and found it to be good-however I am not a big octopus fan in general. Overall the service was good and the food was very fresh and tasty. However, it took a very long time for the food to come out and for that I would deduct a star
Great Sauce on the Calamari both the medium & Hot are great the prices are a little high but the quality is there also great Steamers!

Clams are fantastic here & the stuffed fillet. The calamari tasted bland - sauce (which was great) helped a little, but the fried batter can use a little seasoning. I've had better. They dont serve hard liquor, but beer & wine is available. Not a fancy place but the food is good overall.

Best seafood. Period. Fresh, delicious - haven't tried anything that wasn't 5 stars. The place probably needs some work in terms of looks, but hey you are there for the food in my opinion. The sauce is amazing, you can basically eat that sauce with anything, even by itself.

the crab cake and oyster sandwiches were very good as well as the service. The fried zucchini was exceptional. Very casual. While we did not try it, I understood from the people at the table next to us that the calamari was exceptional as well.

Came here ready to try some yummy food and I was a little disappointed at the combo dish. I ordered fried calamari, shrimp, and mussels. It was a super small dish. I remember it being a bit bigger. I also ordered to chicken franchese which was really good. The chicken was moist and the sauce was just awesome! The price was more than I expected but it was good food.

I can't say their service was great but the not-so-friendly staffs got their job done. Food came out within a reasonable time frame and our dirty dishes were promptly taken. I just wish they would at least smile so we can feel a tad bit more welcomed. I almost felt sorry we were there. 

Anyways, for starters, we ordered three soups: New England Clam Chowder, Lobster Bisque, and Spicy Crab and Corn Chowder. All tasty but don't expect to find a lot of meat in there. 

We also ordered the steamers, which were fresh and super well cleaned! We got two orders of that and did not find a single speck of sand in there. For that reason, I gave them four stars! 

Note: I'm not sure how true this is but from my observations, it's cheaper and more worth the money to eat indoors. I came here a long time ago and ate outdoors. The food was served in disposable containers and the portions were so much smaller!!

Old Brooklyn, New York throwback!! In 2016, you'd be hard-pressed to find a long standing business of any kind with a staff that are obviously family and or have known each other for over 50 years...

It's just a good ole italian seafood spot with by far the MOST DELICIOUS fried calamari and sauce on this side of the equator. 

My meal of choice -- Shrimp parm with linguini!!!!!! MAGNIFICO!!!!
I love the calamari..... but boy the service sucked!! I had to wait for the waitress to finish eating and drinking (chatting ) in order to get my check........

A local gem. You get what's on the menu and plenty of it. My family's been coming here for decades, and we will continue to come back. If you want to order off the menu, then you need to go order somewhere else. It is about his family style as you're going to get right down to the service. It's like asking your great aunt or grandmother for food and to change what they're cooking. It makes me miss my great-grandmother.

This place is consistently good.  No its not health food, although you can get a salad and grilled fish.  For what they do, they are excellent at it.  The ambience is Italian meets like rented hall atmosphere.  It is not particularly pretty and I would not recommend for romantic evening but if you want great Italian fish dishes in a neighborhood that is scenic, go here.

Boy did this place get bad.   $64.20. The calamari plate was the size of the palm of my hand. The calamari was good but the stale bread almost chipped my tooth.  The dozen raw clams and 1/2 dozen oysters were clean and sweet. I figured i will order some more and stared at my waitress for more service.  The staff sat at a table eating and playing with their hair, blowing noses and scratching arm pits. 25mins later i am ready to order more yet i get the check. Every patron was complaining about the service.  Horrible staff.  The place was also filthy and sticky.  A garbage can passing my table was enjoyable.  Thanks Dawn.  Can i get another Corona?
My first experience in this place.i love the food ,but they need little renovation.specially drink should not serve by plastic cups.and needs to be more clean.
I feel so disappointed on the food,they are tasteless,and most of the steam seafood was overcook.Well,only try 1 time and not recommend to friends.

Went last night for my birthday dinner with my husband. The food was amazingly good and the service was great. Our waitress was super friendly and kept asking if we needed something and how was our food. I recommend this restaurant and we will definitely come back again. The prices are typical Emmons Avenue/lobster/clam bar restaurant prices (all locals should know).

At one time, it was  a favorite of mine. Amazing food.   The last time I went it was horrible.  A lot of new people and apparently new cooks. The fish was still fresh and prepared poorly.  When I mentioned to the NEW manager  (son of the owner?)  that I'd been a loyal customer for 30 years and the food was very disappointing, he just shrugged.  I'll never go back.

Well hello. Came here saturday night for a pick up to go. Place was packed girl that took my order was very nice and pleasant. Now wat i ordered was 1 fried calamari it was very small portion and very oily very over priced $15. The shrimp francese with pasta was oily tastless and and it had 5 small shrimp in it. $25 deff not worth it.  And i also got seafood pasta sauce was tasy again thow shrimp very small clams were ok i asked for sayce to be spicy it turned out to be sweet. Total $70 bill. For those 3 items. I would not waste my money again on pasta with tiny shrimp  u r a sucker to eat there
I've been coming here for 20 years and I have to say I have never been disappointed. I love the fried Calama!!

Not bad ... Pasta was aldente. Sauce was sweet. Scungili was a little tough. Mussels in white sauce was very good and he baked clams tasted good but needed less breadcrumbs. Over all the food wasn't bad.

I hate to do this bc the food is good But take out size of soup is terrible, it's like a 7oz cup OMG had I known I would have never order two for $6 and change each! That's insane! I wouldn't pay for a cUp of coffee in this size cup! Shame!

I remember this place from 25 years ago.. and it still looks like 25 yrs ago, even the sauce was 25 yrs old . What a shame , they don't use some of the $ from their overpriced dishes to renovate themselves. They look like an eyesore compared to the venues on the rest of the block .  The entrees were stingy and overpriced . The waitresses needed to retire . I would not recommend this place to anyone , Go to ANY restaurant on the same block , you will get better food , more comfortable seating and not be overcharged for burnt sauce .
Sorry , I wish I had better things to say .., the lobster bisque soup is decent ?

Gets really crowded in the summer and the service isn't the best. My boyfriend claimed that it was going to be the best pasta I've ever tasted but they put way to much sauce and I felt like I was drowning in it. I honestly don't see why people like this place so much.

I'm on the Belt Parkway and stuck in death traffic. I text my Yelp brother from another mother, what the hell is around Coney Island?? I had cravings for a burger and beer. He rattles off a buncha places but one old skool place stuck out, Randazzo's Clam Bar.

This is Brooklyn old school at its finest. And it gets me insane at the same time. I moved from Brooklyn to Port Jefferson. The Steam Room in its wildest dreams should be able to replicate this menu. I see a few fried items but what stuck out is the cherry clams on a half shell. The flesh looks bright and so fresh, did they just pull them off the boat? Wait a second.. are these clams from Jamaica bay?! Haha

Walking in, it's looks like a diner from the 50s. Picture a large open area with tables. To the right is a counter with stools. In front of the stools is a grill where I'm assuming they also do cooking. Is it fancy up in here? Hell no! You want Brooklyn-Italian-Seafood? This is it right here baby!

I walk in and order a beer and a dozen clams. Man, the clams are outtasite! Hey, lemme have a bowl of Manhattan clam chowder with these clams. Soup that is chock full of clams and stuff. Mmmm mm, very fresh.

Pulling up to this place is also straight outta Brooklyn. You back into a parking spot, with a gangsta lean. Very very cool.

If your looking for fresh seafood in Sheepshead Bay, consider Randazzo's Clam Bar. Its not fancy by any means but a neighborhood joint since the 30s.
I came here on 12/27/16 I had the cherry stone clams and the calamari both was delicious very nice place
I've been eating clams at Randazzo's for more than 30 years. It is the best place to get clams and galamah!

They changed my bill after I paid and left tips! Unbelievable!!!! I've got terrible service and I have left $6 tips and waiters changed this amount, I saw in my credit card charged $15 more!!!!!
This is crazy !!!!
Great soup, baked clams, and zuppa di mussels. Their red sauce is so fantastic I take mine home and have it with pasta. Stick to the seafood and you will not be disappointed!
Love this place, food and service is excellent! Historic Brooklyn restaurant. Real deal right here. Totally recommend.

Good seafood is totally out of my price range.  When I see prices like this, I expect the place to be super-fancy.  I prefer a more casual place, though, and this place is more casual.  We had mussels in red sauce - I brought gluten-free bread from home.  We also had Lobster BIsque, which I felt was better at Jordan's Lobster Dock because you could pay extra to have a portion of lobster chunk added to the bisque.
Fresh and delicious!

Never again.  The plastic pitcher and cheap tiny plastic glasses just plopped on your table - complete turnoff.  The pitcher pour out on the table, the plastic water glasses kept toppling over!  For  $50 lobster, a $23 tiny plate of what people would regard as seafood melange, order of clam chowder, can't a waiter pour me a drink?  The food is better at Jordan's.  This place is tacky.

Was in mood for clans on half shell. They were mediocre at best. Had an off taste.  Then ordered fried shrimp. Plain and small.  Biggest complaint was price. Way over what most places charge. They even had sign "cheap seafood is fresh and fresh seafood isn't cheap". I didn't order it but they had soft shell crabs either fried or sautéed. 1 18.95 2 34.95.  I won't be back.

You will spend A LOT of money, but you will leave VERY VERY VERYYYYY S-A-T-I-S-F-I-E-D !!!!

I've never had seafood prepared better than at this place!

Highly reccommended!
Place was terrible. Used to go as a child. $80 for cold hard bread rushed but I have to say the lobster bisque soup was good. So I really paid $80 for a cup of soup!!

In my humble opinion, when you advertise your place as an original old time Italian seafood restaurant your tartare sauce should not be served in a small prepackaged sealed tub. Nope your tartare sauce should be fresh and chunky with fresh herbs. Strike one. 

Crab cakes should not come out of the kitchen two minutes after they're ordered. Some semblance of fresh should be maintained. While there wasn't much filler in the cake, the crab was old tough and stale. And the casing was tasteless and hard.  Strike two. 

Would you like red sauce for those fries?  You betcha I would. But the sauce was run of the mill. From a jar? If I'm asking that question you've got a problem. Strike three. 

So why two stars?  One cause Randazzo's is on Edmond Avenue with lovely views of SheepsheadBay. And two, because our server, Samantha, was the best. But no stars for the food. And when you rate a restaurant no stars for the food, well you've said it all.l

My family and I have been a regular here for some time. We usually go in on a Wednesday to devour some seafood. It's not a fancy place, it's very casual with an old school vibe. They have inside and outside seating. The go to is usually they oysters. They are not the best, but they usually hit the spot. The clams in a garlic sauce is also nice, especially for bread dipping. My entree is usually the king or snow crab sautéed in a garlic sauce with either regular fries or fried zucchini. The fried zucchini is good, but after a while I always find myself peeling off the batter and just eating the zucchini. It has nothing to do with there batter, I do it with all fried foods. The downside for me is they only serve wine, beer or soft drinks. The service is always great. I've never had a complaint with the food or waitresses and will return.

I WAS HARASSED BY "JENNA"
While dining with my family I was scolded by a random waitress "JENNA" for spilling ice and not getting up to find someone to clean it while i am 8 months pregnant with my family eating dinner.  I could not believe this NASTY disgruntled employee talks to customers this way.  "JENNA" then proceeded  to argue with me in front of everyone and sarcastically told me to slip on the ice.  When I adressed the situation with the owner/manager she seemed to be unfazed with JENNAS behavior.  JENNA should be terminated from RANDAZZO's she is A HUGE LIABILITY!!!

I'm now 45 and have been eating here since I was a kid. This is the last of the mohicans of Sheepshead Bay. The best of the best. I now  live in Philly and a Chef make my up , just to eat here. Randazzos is a must eat and the best of the best.

The blue point oysters were amazing. Best I've had in a long time. Excellent New England clam chowder that I could have 2 bowls of. The shrimp cocktail was ok had a water downed taste. The stuffed shrimp and stuffed lobster had a burnt taste as well as the butter for the stuffed lobster. The lobster roll was good not the best I've had but good. The baked potato and fries were really good.

Craving seafood and beautiful weather brought me to Randazzos yesterday. It's my favorite place to get fresh seafood so it is always worth the trip. Their hot sauce is perfection. I do not stray from my usual order. Little neck clams on the half shell, fried calamari and the scungili over biscuit with sauce. Delicious every time. I always order a dish to take home. I love introducing friends to this place, they are always impressed with the freshness of the seafood and become regulars like me. Definitely recommend , their sauce is one of a kind!

Horrible food. Horrible service. Waitress didn't even ask if we enjoyed the food (we didn't)
Walked out hungry and broke.
The crab cake was dry and tasteless. A filet o fish from mcdonalds would have been an upgrade from this.

French fries are pre made frozen. The crab cakes, that the waitress said are made fresh daily, are very bready and deep fried.  Cole slaw is pre prepared.  Baked clams ok, but not much flavor in the breading. I say try another place on the strip of restaurants in Sheepshead Bay.

If you're looking for fresh seafood, especially clams and oysters, without going to far, this is the place to go! Came here twice on an early Saturday afternoon and it wasn't too crowded. It got crowded as the day went. Don't expect this to be like the fancy restaurants near by. However, the food will not disappoint. The raw menu was very fresh and the seafood pasta dish was amazing. Also, must try the zucchini fries!
The place has been around for many years. Inside it looks like a cafeteria. The food is OK, but definitely over priced. The service is lacking.

Always a good time here!  Grew up in Brighton Beach and currently living in Jersey, we do not get the chance to eat really good fried calamari . The sauce is NEVER as good as Randazzos! ( And in Jersey,  they call it cal-a-mary!) So today I ordered a fried calamari,  as I do whenever we come here. There were 5 of us and we shared a variety of dishes. The Lobster roll was fresh and had nice chunks of Lobster. The Fried zucchini is cut in thick pieces,  a little bigger than a fast food French fry,  and fried perfectly to give it a crunchy texture,  while still tasting like a zucchini. We has Zuppa de Mussels with red sauce,  the muscles were tiny but sauce to die for,  had to get more bread to dunk. 
Add in the atmosphere,  and you have the perfect Sheepshead Bay experience. I miss living here!

I see a lot of shitty reviews of this place but I don't know what you really expect this isn't a five star restaurant it's just a super casual spot.

I have been coming here since I was a kid and it's pretty nostalgic for me. I love their stuffed lobster which has a lot of meat from lobster and shrimp filling so it's good and filling.

This place is cute in my opinion because it is no frills kinda place .. you go .. you eat you leave. I like how they have little mini wine bottles. 

The place does get packed really quickly but they do move and do everything rather efficiently

Nice area
Nice beach breeze

Food is good, great sauce!!, garlic bread is hard like stone. 

The Italian kid behind the counter is a bit rude. 

I won't go back.
I've gone to places with great food and great customer service. 

Good Luck!
My husband and I traveled from New Jersey for the steam grilled Collamore (sp) and I enjoyed two varieties of shrimp highly recommend Randazzo.

Damn, are they good!

They say, "It's all about the sauce," but I say it's also about the seafood. As fresh as fresh can be. And they know how to fry! Light, crisp and not at all greasy.

Today for lunch, my wife and I shared a feast from the sea. A dozen Cherrystones, an order of fried calamari, with hot sauce, and a fried soft-shell crab sandwich with fried zucchini. As always, it was all excellent. And we had service with a smile from Angela.

All in all, a delicious lunch on a beautiful day in Sheepshead Bay!

I was very unimpressed with the food at this restaurant.  I ordered the lobster roll,  and my friends had seafood platters. The only enjoyable part of the meal was the fries. The lobster roll had absolutely no taste. I felt like I was eating dry bread because of the lack of flavor. The scallops didn't even taste real. The whole experience was horrendous. I will not be eating here ever again.

Really disappointing. Took my family here when they were visiting from out of town and regretted it. Service was slow and rude-waitress didn't check on us once after our food was delivered. Two of us ordered steamed lobsters which were small and quite rubbery. The baked potato was better than the lobster! Bread provided to the table was hard as a rock. Also ordered the lobster bisque, but personally I think it was more of a chowder. The color was beige and it had potatoes in it. In my experience, lobster bisque is smooth, creamy, and with a tomato base. Only good thing is that the crab cakes one of us ordered were great. I'm not sure if we didn't order "well" or what happened, but not sure why this is a Brooklyn institution.
the seafood is so fresh and please remember to try out the pasta. Yummy yummy. It is a good place to go during the summer time.

Execellent sea food, very fresh great servuce, not super expensive but definitely not cheap.clams are the best I've ever had , sauce is good , some pasta dishes could be a little bland, but good and the pasta is ok not the freshist. But any seafood you get will be excellent. High turnover very busy.

Recomend the shrimp randazzo over pasta 
Recomend paying cash
Drinks are alittle over priced

Delicious food for what could be overlooked as a fast-food joint. The spicy crab chowder should be spicier to qualify for spicy. Other than that, I'm glad I parked some blocks away as I needed to walk for the tasty food.
Wish I would have read these posts before spending $225 for lunch. Food was ok. It isn't worth the price. Order two meals to go and they didn't even give bread.
Tried out the cherry stone clams and lobster roll. It was satisfying and delicious. Service was amazing and top notch. They were always attentive. Would definitely come back.

It's just off the Belt Parkway. It's about a 10 minute walk from the Sheepshead Bay subway stop and about a 15 minute walk from the Brighton Beach boardwalk. 

Randazzo's Clam Bar Restaurant is casual. Service is great. Staff are friendly. Prices are moderate. It's not very expensive but it's also not cheap. 

I really really liked the Lobster bisque soup and the fried clams. I recommend them both. 
I wasn't as big of a fan of the fried calamari and the baked clams. They were just okay.

Was there on a beautiful Saturday afternoon looking for some oysters and clams what better place than here! 
Well, while we waited for the clams to arrive, I decided to head to the ladies room to relieve myself when suddenly I hear a frantic knock on the door "anybody In there" (2x's) I yell back "be right out" (2x's)! As I wash my hands I hear the door open & it was a waitress. She quickly walks away never apologized for rudely opening the door, just walks away! 
As soon as I walked out I address the waitress by saying " usually if the door is locked means someone's there" key word being USUALLY.  She then goes on to say to me " no it doesn't the door has been known to lock on its own..." Blah blah blah is all I heard after this because I still never heard her say" hey I am so sorry but here is why I opened the door" (using the master key) In this waitress defense the place should either have a bathroom specifically for wait staff or they need to put in a little $$ into this place and revamp the bathrooms so that there can be a couple of stalls which can alleviate this type of situation.  I did go ahead and report this incident to management as all he did was say "oh I am sorry to hear this happpened".... Anyhow it soured my moment there & then as I go outside to my table I continue to hear the waitresses arguments over who has what tables. Clearly the older waitress was trying to hustle out the newbie younger waitress who was trying to make $$ herself. In any case, do you think patrons need to hear all this staff issues etc when trying to relax, have some raw oysters & clams?? No! Unacceptable behavior from the staff. The raw seafood was good, fresh and didn't disappoint but I will never come back here to risk being stressed out by staff!! For this reason I give then 2 stars, what ashame!

Went to eat at Randazzo's yesterday afternoon. Wow, this place is great!! What really blew my mind , was the sauce that was on top of the calamari. It actually tasted like my mother's homemade gravy (sauce) !!!! Any Italian American reading this knows that it is very hard to find at a restaurant. Our waitress was the cutest. She kept checking on us to make sure we were okay, and she kind of reminded me of my grandma, loved her. So Randazzo's gets 5 stars from me!!

This will be a quick one.  There is no wonder why Anthony Bourdain put this seafood restaurant on his top favorites Broonklyn, NY list. Absolutely amazing seafood, great environment,  good prices, great experience. 

Bathrooms could use an upgrade but who cares in an old school joint to be honest.  

Staff is phenomenal!!!!!! But that red sauce.... DAMN!

Food- awesome!, $ 3.00 for an 8 oz coke, not so good. I felt like I was nickeled and dimed. Seriously, that little thing Left  a bad taste in my mouth . Too overpriced for even so called fresh food! I'll pass on them. Just principles that's all!

I'm not a seafood eater. I believe it's unsustainable and as a marine biologist I feel strangely eating the same things I study in textbooks. I'm also a vegan within a family that loves seafood and is largely Italian from Brooklyn- so this place is a family favorite. My review is based solely on if you happen to be vegetarian or vegan going to this restaurant because of your family or something of that nature. 
I didn't like how they came out with plastic cups and a plastic water pitcher- it was so tacky. You can't have water glasses? Got a really rude waitress (didn't catch her name). I ordered the pasta with garlic and oil. I asked if she had any vegetables I could get on the side like asparagus, zucchini, brocolli, etc and she gave me a look like I was out of this world- completely surprised by any mention of vegetables. She said "The only vegetable we have is fried zucchini." And scoffed at me. Sorry, I understand this is an old time Italian place, but you can't offer VEGETABLES to put with pasta? By the way, the dish I ordered made me feel so sick due to the excess amount of olive oil. I know traditional Italian food done right and this really isn't. It was like my linguini was sitting in a vat of olive oil, almost like a soup. The garlic was over cooked and had that gross bitter flavor that garlic has when it is overdone. Just vomited up the dish actually because it was so overdone with the amount of oil. I really don't recommend this place for anyone who isn't stuffing their face w/ seafood or meat. You won't find anything good. :(

The food is excellent but the portions are small and it is overpriced. I paid $8 for a house salad, which was just lettuce and two tomatoes, which weren't ripe.
The portions shrunk over the years and the prices went up.
The calamari is the best, and the sauce is really good. The parking lot is so small you can't park. You have to park in the street, which is a joke,

I was on my way to a boatride and was feeling peckish i decided to stop there for a quick bite to eat. But decision ever i had the clam chowder which got  up from me the french fries were very crispy and nice talk about delicious mozzarella sticks. Hoping to go back soon.

I must say this place was not easy to review... so I'm going to break it down a little bit.. THE food is awesome, but not all of it is.. I stick with the pasta dishes covered in my favorite fra diavolo sauce and shell fish.  Stick with that and you won't be disappointed. The service is... well it's hit or miss.  The wait staff will vary in friendliness, but they are all helpful.  Just don't come here expecting some young bubbly fake service, it is what it is..  the decor is ok.. in fact it was upgraded a few years back.  Authentic?? I don't know honestly, I've herd mixed reviews on this one but frankly I don't care.. I go there to enjoy some of my favorite dishes in NYC without all the bs that usually comes with great food establishments.

At best a 1-star eatery that charges and 'thinks' it's a 4-star restaurant. Upon entering this eatery, it was pretty empty at peak lunch hour (that should hv been a big warning). But we were hungry and hoped for the best. Ordered the NE clam cowder which was full of flour, no clams. Their 'filet sandwich' was frozen flounder and not fresh at all. For $17 it should at least have been, fresh. The only decent plate was the clams on half shell. With one more entree, bill came out to $75 w tax and 15% tip! Truly ridiculous for below mediocre food. Really don't understand the 4 star rating. AND horrible, dated decor. DATED.
Seriously, whoever rates this place w 4 or 5 stars is either drunk or a family member. AVOID!
The calamari is outrageous, and that sauce alone is worth its weight in gold. Never had a meal here that I didn't enjoy so they'll be seeing me again soon

I've never seen a place as ridiculous as this! I walk in with my husband at around 5:30 we are seated right away as there were not many people in the place. Wait 10 minutes waitress finally comes over takes our drink order then comes back in 5 mins with 2 sodas takes our order ... at this point I've already asked for bread 3 times to no avail ... waitress tells bus boy mike to get it he nods his head and never brings it so the waitress comes over and brought it finally! Food was ok ... nothing special ... service is beyond terrible ... realized as we were eating that there were 5!!!! Waitresses sitting down eating dinner while only our waitress serves 5 or 6 tables by herself ... unreal! How could they allow such bs ... then we get our food eat and I notice now our waitress sits to eat so we're sitting there like idiots waiting and waiting and waiting ... never had such terrible service and my husband and I go out A LOT!!! The bill comes finallllllllyyy and we're able to get out of this place .... place is a rip off ... totally over priced and food is just ok ... service is beyond horrific .... place is a joke ... Clemente's is wayyyyy better!

Anytime of the year it is a great place to stop for seafood.  My daughter loved their lobster salad (lobster roll).  It's right on the water in Sheepshead Bay.  You can eat inside or outside to watch the fishing boats.   Hasn't changed much over the years, which is a good thing,

Four years ago I happily rated this place 5 stars. Today it is not. Food is still great, but service I received yesterday sucked beyond bad. Waitress looked grossly preoccupied with her own issues and was kind of abrupt and would just walk away when I was still in mid-sentence. When I go for dinner, it is to make my life better and forget my issues for at least an hour, not to pay $70 to deal with someone else's emotional baggage. Who serves Zuppe Di Mussel without even a plate to put out empty shells on? Well, she does. My wife and I were humbly  piling it on a small plate for bread until it was about to spill over onto the table, finally I asked a bus boy to take it away and replace, which he did, but he still brought us only one, so my wife and I had to share it for the rest of the dinner. Waitress was just walking by, occasionally stepping outside to make a phone call on her cell (I could see through the glass). Then she just walked by and silently dropped the bill onto the table. I mean- silently as in not a single freaking word, not a tiniest "thanks", just dropped the bill on the table. My wife made a comment about younger waitresses serving other tables "other girls are so nice and attentive" Guess we drew the short straw that day. We both agreed that her whole demeanor sucked and had a short discussion on how much to tip. I decided to still tip and wrote it on the check. Moments later I saw waitress nearby and turned to her to ask some question, she looked straight at my face, clearly saw my mouth saying something addressing her and just walked right by without even slowing down and completely ignoring me. That was the last straw. At this point, I was sooo ticked off, I crossed out tip on the check and wrote "no tip, unfriendly service". Food is great! Try calamari! Just make sure one of the younger waitresses serves your table. Not because of age, no. Because they will provide a much much better service with a smile, based on what we saw. One of them actually saw what I wrote on the bill and came over with apologies, even though it was not her table.

Great seafood so fresh and delicious, but oh so expensive. Their calamari was so unbelievable, there red sauce was to die for as well. however,$24 for an appetizer. A bit much and the portion isn't that big. For my main course I went with the shrimp parmigiana. Very fresh and so yummy. I would definitely check out Randazzo's again if I'm in Sheepshead Bay

I've been coming here for years, but it never dawned on me that i should review them. I started coming here when Joe's Clam Bar was still down the block. Sadly, they are no longer there. The thing to get here is the Fried Shrimp ($14.95); personally I'm addicted to Shrimp "Hot", which means it's covered with a spicy version of homemade tomato sauce. You can also get it "Mild" if you're not into spicy food; your tomato sauce is still delicious, but not peppery hot. The only side that comes with the shrimp is a hard crusty roll, but somehow that is enough. When it's chilly out like last night, I order a bowl of New England Clam Chowder ($7) too. So creamy and delicious, and filling. Beer/wine is $6. So a check for 2 with just those 3 items each including tax runs $60.85! Not cheap at all by anyone's standards, but it's a great treat to have a few times a year. Their sauce is just amazing, so tasty! I prefer to sit at the counter instead of a table; when you order there, your food comes pretty quickly without much attitude. Sadly, the same cannot be said when sitting at a table. Just be prepared to drive around the block a few times before you find parking if you go when it's busy. They do have quite a following so the dinner crowd doesn't dwindle until much later at night. If you go during the day, it's easier to find parking and be seated without much hassle or wait. If you've never been to Sheepshead Bay, go and definitely stop here for good food!

For a restaurant that has been around for over a 100 years it is still Fresh, has the fastest service, filled with friendly staff! 

They have everything you'd want from a seafood restaurant - soup, fresh oysters, clams, scallops, 
Octopus (all can be fried or baked if you want) 

Sandwiches, pastas with all the seafood you want- they have beer as well if you want to pair it with your seafood dishes. But omggg their pasta! The noodles are handmade- so fresh!! Their garlic/olive oil linguine- I wish you could smell the garlic when the dish comes out- please check out all my pics- no need any special frills- 

Locals and tourists all come to check out this historic place- it's definitely a staple and will be around for another 100 years or more!

Yo, honestly it is so hard to find good food nowadays. Like genuinely good, home cooked food and Randazzo's does it. It was my first time and everything was a amazing that I tried. The Spicy Corn Chowder was evvvveeryythanngg! The pasta sauce was delicious and included the perfect amount of garlic. Vodka sauce was a homemade recipe, first time I actually tasted the vodka in a sauce. My waitress Sam was so sweet and helpful with me picking the best pick on the menu and she never missed the mark with each suggestion. 

Randazzo's is the key to success!!!! 

My new stable!
Just stopped by with some friends for an old favorite: baked clams.  Always a winner. They had the calamari and loved it.

My first visit to Randazzo's hands down the greatest seafood meal I've had in years. Cannot wait to go back. A very nice place, good service. Everyone I was with enjoyed their meals also. Everything looked so good it was hard to decide. Definitely coming back.

I graduated to this joint at around 10 years of age.  My father and I would spend a day walking around the Bay, fishing, visiting relatives, and usually end up with ice cream - nothing fancy, probably Good Humor.  One day when he asked me if I wanted ice cream, I asked for littlenecks instead and never looked back.  From there it went to calamari, scungili (doesn't spellcheck) and shrimp with hot sauce (and those rock-like rolls) from a pot that had been simmering since the Great Depression.  Have never sat at a table here, only at the clam bar ordering plate after plate of fried seafood with spicy red.  There's simply nothing like it anywhere else (though there used to be several along the water - this is the lone holdout).
Haven't been back in years, and that's the only star deduction - I once flew 3,000 miles and then drove from mid-town for a plate of squid, and missed closing time by 10 minutes.  I pleaded and begged, told my story, you could see and smell the sauce still simmering, but no go.  Food is a serious vendetta to hold.
Try it while it's still around.

Love this place ! My husband and I we come here for more than 7 yrs , we always happy and satisfied with the food ! The only thing is you want a eat fast make sure you seat at the bar , the waitress take so long .... ( for everything) ! But yes 5

Ever been to a place with great food and the food tastes exactly the same each and every time? Well that's randazzo !! The sauce is so consistent. I have a few favorites the mild calamari, clam chowder, shrimp parm and chicken parm. The staff is very friendly as well. I go to randazzo at least once a month.

We were there last night for dinner.
The atmosphere wasn't the greatest, felt cafeteria like. The "dixie cup" water/glass service was just plain weird. Food was tasteless. Our waitress was good though. 
Way overpriced  for the whole experience.
Moderately above average seafood at a highly above average price. A coffee cup size of soup should not be $13-16.

Just as advertised!

To be honest, prior to my latest visit I never knew Randazzo's was featured on Anthony Bourdain's No Reservations in 2012, and nor did I need it to be featured on that show to know that this institution existed near me. For almost all of my life, I lived near one of the great seafood establishments in Brooklyn, located way too far south for some to "trek" to, but very well worth the long train ride.

I had once visited the restaurant a long time ago, way before I knew what good food was, so it only made sense for me to make the pilgrimage back ... and that time was now! I dropped in with my wife on MLK day and the restaurant was fairly quiet compared to the spring and summer nights where I passed by. By the end of the evening when we left at 8pm, the restaurant only had 6-7 parties inside, which we honestly did not mind since it was nice and peaceful.

From the moment we stepped in, till the moment we left, the service was fantastic. ALL, and I cannot stress this enough, ALL of the waiters and waitresses were extremely friendly throughout the evening -- to us and to other parties. The menu was pretty daunting as there were many seafood and Italian dishes to choose from, so we did our research on the more popular dishes way before we walked in. Based on our research, and the flavors our tastebuds love, we went with the following:

New England Clam Chowder (Bowl)
- Hearty and very tasty. There was a fair amount of potatoes and clams inside. Since it was cold outside, the warm chowder really hit the spot. On the bad side, there were a few sandy spots in the chowder, but not enough to really bother us that much.

Baked Clams (Cherry Stones)
- Another winner. Unfortunately, there were only 10 clams in the order because we could have easily just kept on going and going and going. The clams were big and baked really well. The breading used on the clams were very flavorful, especially when the squeezed lemon was sprinkled onto it.

Fried Calamari (with sauce on top)
- This is the dish many come here for and it did not disappoint. The red sauce was so tasty and just right. It wasn't too thick and wasn't too liquidity either. The calamari was easy to chew thru and fried well. The batter on the calamari maybe could have used a little bit more crunch, but the sauce really softened it up quickly, so the crunchiness of them wouldn't last long.

Shrimp Fra Diavolo (On A Bed Of Pasta shrimp, clams & mussels in a red spicy sauce)
- Probably our least favorite dish, but that probably has more to do with our preferences. We decided to order this since we saw so many pictures of it. Unfortunately, the sauce was a bit more watery than we liked and we weren't big fans of the entire dish because it was basically just linguine with red sauce and seafood. With that said, it still wasn't that bad and pretty flavorful. I'm more of a chicken parm pasta dish kind of guy, so this was far from my 1st choice, but we went with it anyway to share.

Overall, we really couldn't complain. The restaurant wasn't crowded on the night we went and the food was good. Like I said earlier, the service was also excellent and the folks working there couldn't be more friendly. Are there a few things they could fix? Sure ... but it wasn't the end of the world and none of the negative things ruined our meal.

FYI - For you T-shirt collectors, they sell T-shirts advertising the restaurant.

Love this restaurant that's been in my neighborhood for over 30+ years.  Been here many times with my friends and family.  Their Manhattan Clam chowder is sooo good. If you want good Italian Seafood this is a must try.  I love their Steamers.  We went last night and they didn't have any because it's not on season.  We ordered s dozen cherry stones, chicken cutlet parmigiana, mixed seafood rigatoni & linguini in white clam sauce.   Everything was delicious.

First time in this place in 20+ years having lunch with two lovely ladies, the friendly staff and fast service was great but the star of the menu was the New England clam chowder it was scrumptious ,thick ,tasty creamy,filling and delicious also The wonderful lobster roll and fried oysters and the large order of zucchini fries were great. This place is a part of history it has a Nostalgic feel to it ,the food was good then and it is good Now-Go and enjoy it!

Visiting family in Brooklyn and had to come back 
here. It was everything it ever was. Good service. Good food and Great atmosphere. Nice to know some things don't change. The calamari and mussels were tops.

My first time to Brooklyn and this food was amazing we went 2 times in the few days we were there 
We had fried calamari and the shrimp Fra diavello on pasta the first day we got into town and it was my favorite seafood dish I have ever had. The red sauce was amazing. The second time we went in we had cherry stones and lobster bisque which we enjoyed but I was craving the fra diavello from our first visit!  We shared the chicken parm and it was just ok... could of been because I was looking at the table over that ordered the plate I should of ordered again!  Wait staff was super friendly both evenings

It's been a long long time since I have been at Randazzos.  I peomised my wife JoAnn that we will get to Sheepshead Bay to eat at Randazzos and check out Bayfest 2018, and later walk on the Boardwalk.

Service and quality of food is great! Ask waitress about the menu and she'll be happy to advise ypu and tell you popular recommendations. Foods are in large portion. If you dont eat a lot, its great to share. Thank you! They accept cash and credit.

A must-go place in Brooklyn for amazing fried calamari, white clam chowder, .... oh and the sauce!!

The only thing I can't stand is that the waitresses always add a few cents to the tax to make the final bill a "nice" number. When I let the manager know that I was displeased with that, she said, "It must be because we don't deal with pennies."  Oh really?? Then take those pennies OFF my bill! She did not. I'll never not go back though so waddayagonnado!?

That sauce! Yes they are all right that the sauce is worth the trip. We got the king crab legs that came with a side of butter. We got the colossal shrimp that were grilled and butterflied which came in a butter lemon sauce. We also got the seafood combo that was covered in their famous marinara sauce which contained fried calamari, fried shrimp, and steamed conch. I was underwhelmed with the fried seafood, because I expected steamed. Why ruin fresh seafood by dredging it in flour? The waitress was very friendly, and the place was clean. It's not fancy, and the prices are not cheap as you would expect considering it's a seafood place. Glass for your water? Nope, only small plastic cups for you. Would I come again? Yes! This is the first spot I ever had lobster in as an 11 year old kid fresh in the country. This place is a landmark.
I love this restaurant, my wife and I have been coming here since the eighties. We love the shrimp with medium sauce. We have never had a bad meal here. Wait staff and owners are so very friendly.

So .... perhaps I went on a bad night!
Let's hope so because my experience there Wednesday 4/18/18 was not good!

I have dined here many times but that was over 5 years ago!
I'm nostalgic and wanted to re-visit a Brooklyn institution but ..... 

I ordered Shrimp Francaise which is not easy to do well ... but I figured Randazzo's could pull it off!
WRONG!
Too much lemon and not enough butter and garlic, but the real problem was the shrimp!
Not fresh! Mushy texture, bland taste!
My friend had fried shrimp with pasta and tomato sauce!
Simple ... but also not good!
I don't know the reason for their decline but I am very disappointed!

Very laid back and causal  location..

the broiled lobster was cooked to perfection 
The New England clam chowder was heaven 
Fries were crispy as I love them 
Baked clams were delish
I took a lobster bisque Home and devoured it at dinner ..the flavor was so goooddddd

In the mood for a casual whatever seafood kinda place..this is for you.

I was in the mood for shrimp at Randazzo's today for lunch. I havent been there is about 4 years. I ordered the shrimp and was very dissappointed. The shrimp was tough and I do not know if it was under cooked or overcooked. Very chewing and not good but the sauce is still so good. I was serve by a guy in his 20's that seem like he really did not want to be there. I will not be going back. It was so good when Pauly was around

JR
Calamari was tender and crispy! Shrimp oreganato, light and flavorful with zucchini. Linguine with mild sauce so tasty. More then enough clams in chowder!

I've been coming to this place since I was a kid the food is amazing...try the fried calamari you can get it with medium or hot marinara sauce with the sauce on top or the side it will change your life

You can't help but come across Randazzo's while strolling through the neighborhood, especially during summertime walks.  It's situated smack in the middle of the bay so stumbling in could be a good option ... if you enjoy seafood.  The interior has a laid back casual theme and nice and clean, and the waitstaff is friendly and accommodating.  We had the Zuppa Di Pesce in Randazzo's infamous red sauce -- the mussels, shrimp, and clams were all fresh and very flavorful.  The colossal shrimp and Alaskan king crab were incredible!  Overall, the best part of coming here is definitely the red sauce.  Whatever you order ... always make sure that it comes with the red sauce.

The food: fantastic!!! They weren't lying when they said FRESH! You should expect to pay more for the quality, but I promise it's quality. Approximately $30/adult for supper, including a combo plate for the table, a few drinks, and massive bowls of pasta, delicious sauce, and enough seafood to satisfy this fat Arkansas girl's stomach.

The service: also fantastic! Our waitress was a doll and she kept us all refilled and happy. Incredibly friendly staff.

The atmosphere: very casual and low-key. 

This is definitely going to be a go to place for us every time we're ever in the area.
Great place for a snack! Fresh clams and calamari. They do fill up plate with bread and that should be more calamari.. sauce that your nonna would approve of.
I come here all the way from Virginia Beach I had to have my muscles, scungilli and of course mussels over linguine love you guys see you on my next trip to New York Sheepshead Bay you rock
This the number one stop for seafood in Brooklyn. This place is fresh and the prices are on point. If you don't know what you want get the combo. This will give you a taste of sheepshead bay.

Fresh seafood isn't cheap and cheap seafood isn't fresh!  But I'm not even going to talk about prices.   This is a local institution; over the years it's earned my respect and business by consistently providing great seafood and good service. 

My favorite item here is the linguine with clam sauce. Big pieces of clam with perfectly cooked al dente pasta in a nice flavorful sauce.  Another favorite is fried calamari, aka "galamah".   It's probably the most popular item on the menu.  Also, the bisque is worth trying. 

Long story short, if you are in sheepshead bay and you want seafood, head here.  The rest of us already do.

If I can give no stars I would. My boyfriend and I are new to the area but we've heard from multiple people that this place was one to check out. 
On Sunday 6/17/2018
* service* horrible our server hardly acknowledged us as we sat by the outside tables she was probably to busy smiling and laughing into her phone to pay attention. Also forgot to put in one of our orders til we asked where it was.

* food * steamed mussels / mild sauce was bland no flavor and slightly chewy 
Pasta with clams-sauce mediocre
Pasta marechiara " sauce " was watery and flavorless 
For a total of $70 the food was trash service was horrible 
I'd rather pay $200 elsewhere than $.01 here never again
Haven't been here in years and I'm back for some calamari and steamers. The place the service are great so come check out this place

The best shrimp scampi fra diavolo and calamari in nyc.

Always fresh.

Family owned. 

Sit outside in the summer!

The best chowder we've ever had. We ordered fried calamari, half-does oysters, sautéed king crab.
In all, foods were fresh, service was attentive.

I took a star away, due to the portion of serving were NOT very generous, half-portion plates while the $$ is not.

Fresh seafood is not cheap.. lol..
But it was nice.. ive ordered Fried calamari, Manhattan chowder and half-does of cherry stone.. definitely be there again..

Nice place to get some seafood. All items we ordered were great. We tried all soups and found them to be amazing.  Baked clams were good but on the small size. The fried calamari and shrimp were great.  Mussels were also on the small size but the sauces were so good

To the reviewer with the one star, complaining about lack of over zealous service....welcome to Brooklyn!  LOL  Went to Randazzo's Sunday (7/1), after a day at Coney Island.  Ordered a famous dozen CherryStones, so delicious (yes, seafood ain't cheap if it's good), followed by the clam chowder......stuffed and very happy....and yes, reminiscing too is a cool thing, a staple of Brooklyn forever.

I was pretty underwhelmed by this place. My friends and I had come before we went to Falada for drinks with our coworkers. We had ordered the clams (zuppa di pesce - I THINK), chicken parm linguini and the tilapia. We each also ordered a cup of soup - I had the spicy crab corn chowder.

The clams were okay and I sort of expected more on the plate than whatever we had. The chicken parm was something I wished we had not ordered because it was pretty disappointing to me - the sauce was very liquidy. I suppose that is why we should not order something like that here at a seafood restaurant (unfortunately, I'm allergic to shrimp so we couldn't order the alternative to what we had). My spicy crab corn chowder was also just okay - even though I rarely have something like that. The best was definitely the tilapia with the fries. The fries were SO ON POINT. 

My verdict? Would I go back willingly? Probably not. If my friends wanted to go? I'd give it another chance to WOW me.

I would've given them 4 stars but charging me $3 for 8oz Pepsi is ridiculous and to top it off they give you a little small plastic cup. Yes the kind I used to get from the corner store for 5 cents. Service was slow but the food was awesome. The fried fish was fresh as was the Alaskan king crab legs. The prices are reasonable. I'm definitely coming back

Great clams, good food, good and fast service. A family restaurant you don't need to dress up for.

The food was good. But you can't have a good experience with such horrible customer service.

Excellent food in a relaxed atmosphere and reasonably priced. Best Shrimp Parmigiana I've ever had and the spicy sauce is a must! Great Clams and Galamah. Been coming here for years and will Continue to do so.

The calamari was very good but we ordered it with the hot sauce on the side. It was some of the worst sauce we've ever had in an Italian restaurant and it wasn't spicy at all. I had the linguini with clam sauce. It had very little flavor and needed copious amounts of salt to give it any flavor at all. I would have thought a seafood restaurant would have some clams in their shells on top. My husband had a very overcooked lobster. The prices were that of a much better restaurant in Manhattan without the nice atmosphere. better service and much better food. It was a disappointment to say the least.

I've been here before and the food was better. This time around, we ordered something different and it was a disappointment. From service to the quality of the food. First off, the water took forever to come. Second, the food: We ordered the fried fish dish which comes with 1 piece of fish, 2 shrimp, 4 oysters and 3 scallops and some fries. (Definitely not worth 30 bucks if you ask me!) This plate was overfried and over breaded.  Sad to say that the fries were the star of the dish.  We also ordered the shrimp randazzo which comes with around 7 shrimp, 2 clams, 2 mussels and linguini which tasted bland.  The manhattan clam chowder was decent. We had to ask for the bread after I noticed that all the other tables had bread. Overall, I think Randazzos has gone downhill.  Probably won't be back anytime soon.

I've been eating calamari here for the better part of 30 years... before Yelp! As far back as I can remember, I've never had anything less than 5 stars! 
I've eaten it all here. Clams, lobsters, burnt chicken, you name it, I've had it. But when I land, at any one of these NY/ NJ based airports, I can almost smell that calamari and, THE SAUCE! It's not cheap, and the portion is not tremendous. But man oh man, is it soft, tender and tasty! No matter where I am, or where I go, I never doubt. Randazzo's has the best calamari and lobster bisque I've ever eaten in my entire life!

Best calamari and baked clams that I have ever had; very good lobster fra diavolo and most everything else is very good. My parents as well used to come here, and they were very fussy, so it's very good to see that they continue to serve quality food.

Some of the servers have been there not years, but decades. This is a plus. Prices are reasonable and the portions are good as well. 

One caveat: They serve soda in the old fashioned small bottles - while nice, no need to charge $3 each. C'mon.

Casual, with bar service where you can have the full menu as well. 

There's good reason they have been here for 50 years; hopefully they will be here for 50 more.

I ordered the New England Clam Chowder and Pasta with Garlic and Oil. The clams in the chowder were sprinkled with sand and the pasta had no taste at all. The staff was horrible too, in the middle of an order our waitress just walked away and came back 20 minutes later. When I asked what happened she just laughed it off. Just a disaster of a meal.

This is the worst restaurant I visited ever!
Today, My wife and I visited the restaurant because this one got very high rate on google. my wife ordered a lobster roll, soft shell crab and a grilled octopus. we asked the old lady who served us if the lobster is fresh before we ordered the roll, cause the price even more expensive than luke's lobster. she said it's fresh. when the roll came, we found the lobster meet is icy and fragmentary.
