I don't know how the manager manage this restaurant, I only can say "SUCKs!!!"

I've probably came here on a really off day, food and service was just way off. Decided to nosh on a seafood lunch, with only three tables of patron thought this would be the perfect time. Waitress didn't seen too upbeat to serve her three tables, food came out super fast with only lukewarm temperatures. My new England clam chowder was a huge bust (felt like something I could do at home). The Alaskan King Crab had a distinct taste of freezer burn. Under the recommendation of the waitress the Shrimp Pasta tasted decent. I really wanted to like this place as it's been a popular mainstay in Sheepshead Bay, but I just came on a very off day.

This is ole school Sheepshead Bay, don't come here expecting the crystal & chrome of the other restaurants that have taken over the neighborhood.  Food is as good as ever, fried calamari ( bus boys have t-shirts that give a Brooklyn ese pronunciation) hot, crisp & fresh! Chowder - not one drop left in the bowl.  My sister had lobster Randazzo and I had stuffed shrimp. No fuss eatery with seafood the way it's suppose to be - mangia!

First, let me start by saying that this is a Brooklyn institution. I chuckle when I see wide-eyed hipsters pouring through the doors at the advice of Time Out NY or some blog dedicated to pioneering the "uncharted depths" of the borough. Good for them for having a sense of adventure. 

As you can tell, I'm from here, and Randazzo's has always been the traditional lunch treat after visiting adjacent manhattan beach. The food is no frills, but always, always fresh. I recently had a soft shell crab sandwich that was insanely delicious. The crab was huge and clearly caught that morning or just the day before. You could just tell by the taste and feel. 

They have their quirks: the small glass soda bottles which are charming but never enough to satisfy your thirst (so you have to buy 2-I guess that's the point), the tiny plastic cups, or the colorful but almost always friendly waitresses...like I said, it's an institution, and it's been around since way before brooklyn became trendy. 

Favorites include the fried calamari in hot marinara sauce, fried shrimp, their fried zucchini, their huge lobster roll and their always-delicious lobster bisque. Bon apetito from Brooklyn!

First time in this establishment, not the most attractive place, but doable. The waitress was attentive and pleasant. I ordered the chicken parm with spaghetti, the chicken parm was good, but the spaghetti was tasteless. This place needs cleaning, the tables are sticky and bathrooms are nasty. No plans of ever returning.

Great beach day at Riis Park and the Bazaar. Decided to hit up Sheepshead Bay on the way back to the City. Hadn't been since I was a kid and boy has it changed. Very few of the old Italian American joints remain and sadly beautiful Old Lundy's is long gone but with a damn good Russkie gourmet food market named Cherry Hill in its place. Very happy to see old Randazzo's Clam Bar still standing which I heard got hit hard by Sandy. Had to check it out. Place was a blast! Bustling, with picnic tables outside, big clam bar where they shuck the little necks and cherrystones right in front of you and set up with a cold brew. Grabbed a table and had a couple dozen baked cherrystones, fried "galima" with hot sauce, linguini with white clam sauce, shrimp oreganato, grilled lobster and of course the mixed seafood with "the sauce".  Awesome, fun feast and very reasonable. Even the servers were a hoot and very friendly, in a gruff South Brooklyn way. Then hit up the food place at Lundy's for some great ice and gelato which we ate while strolling along the water checking out the fishing boats. Forget the faux Italian American wannabes, if you want a taste of Ole Skool Brooklyn Cugine Cuisine, Randazzo's is still the place!

Cheap and delicious italian seafood joint in the heart of Sheepshead Bay. Young adult date spot perfect for an older adult to go and gawk at young couples in love while stuffing their face full of pasta and expanding. 
For some reason I grab a handful of mints and candy on my way out only from here.

It was a nice dining experience i had here. Friday night i figured it would be a good spot to hit with 6 friends and we were not disappointed.  It was capacity of people dining, but not full or big lines to get in. We were seated right away and our waitress Inna was a trip. She not only took care of our orders, she also took care of our laughs. Dont get me wrong, she is a professional there and really looks out for her customers. We ordered a variety of things. Zucchini fries which were good; baked clans which were also good; the scungilli i was not really into. It does not have flavor for me and they put the red sauce on top. I added some tabasco sauce and red pepper flakes to give it a notch up. At the point it was ok for me to eat. We had 2 bottles of wine, one white and a zinfandel.  They chilled right but not cold which we liked. Now we ordered mostly Lobster tail which for me was priced affordable. It was $30, but it was a very nice size portion. The other dinner we ordered was the shrimp scampi over spaghetti.  That is a huge protion and it was really good. At the point i needed a nap.  I asked Inna to carry me to the car amd she was her cheery smart self and cracked jokes right back!! Loved her a our server.

I would always recommend this place just for the fresh seafood and the sassy waitresses.

We have been visiting Randazzo's for many many years now. We love the steamers and their cherrystones, which are always super fresh and a great mouth full. 

Our go to dishes are the Chicken parmagiana and shrimp fra diavolo, which is a must. The sauce is super flavorful and it has a nice kick to it.

I will say that their service is a little old school and could be taken up a notch. Their busboy however is great! He was there then he was gone but now he's back!
Food food from seafood seafood. Good good quality fresh fresh zero day freshie was seafood! Just watch out for the price. see Pic

We were strolling the romantic Sheepshead Bay docks when we came across this seemingly adorable family owned establishment.  The queues began to form and we were certainly interested at that point.  

The lines appear to be super long, but the wait is only 15-20 minutes considering how large the restaurant is.  This is likely dependent on how many tourists / Manhattan-nites / Hipsters are visiting because of the Time Out Magazine referral.  (I also belong in one of these categories).  

First, let me say that the experience is likely determined by which waiter you get.  My waitress was extremely polite and friendly and apologized for the wait.  The table beside me had a seemingly abrasive waitress and they walked out rather disappointed.  

Now, onto the food ratings:

Softshell crab - Both were unavailable on the menu that night.  I was extremely disappointed.  

Fried calamari and red sauce - The dish did live up to its reputation and was nicely crispy.  The red sauce was very flavorful and tomato-ey.

Steamers - These were FULL of sand.  I should have read the reviews carefully and many people have rated this dish poorly because of this.  I am well aware that steamers have sand and they need to be rinsed out.  However, it was super abundant and the steamers were sitting in the sandy, muddy hot water with no alternative dish.  Every bite had an uncomfortable crunch.  I was not a fan.  See photos for detail.

The rest of the food looked pretty average, but this was the best looking restaurant in the neighborhood.
I love this place. Calamari is the best I've ever tried. My husband used to frequent this place as a kid. Every time we visit NYC...We eat At Randazzo's:))

to the idiot's who leave reviews based on the price. if you can't swing going out to eat economically, learn to cook"! please tell me taste, smell, presentation,  service, not price!?! if i worried about price i'd stay home!

As many others have written this place is a Brooklyn institution....
For me Randazzo's has always been about the Clams....Clams on the 1/2 Shell, Steamers, Clam Chowder, Baked Clams....All Excellent!!!!
It's not Cheap but it's Damn Good  :-)
I am already looking forward to my next visit...

I gave the restaurant four stars for the food, which is seafood perfection. However, there is no ambiance and our server was was extremely nonchalant and apathetic and most of the time non-existant. More times than I can count I saw her sitting in a corner playing her phone.
Best fried calamari in Sheepshead bay. As far as mains i either get linguini in white clam sauce or spaghetti with shrimp and lobster sauce. Both are A1 choices.
one my my favorite place for new England clam chowder, white clam sauce with linguine.

Fav spot hands down... no pretense... grab a bottle of Zinfandel,or a beer and a bib and just chow down. I've been coming here for almost 16 years and the food has not changed. Fav dish is the lobster fra diavolo and the chicken parm....I would say summer time is the best time to go but it really doesn't matter . Really a cool place to hang out. After you eat just head to the boats and enjoy the scenery. Great for large families and children as well. Definitely a staple in Brooklyn!

I haven't been to this place in ages but it definitely unchanged. The food is just as I remembered it. Fresh and out of this world. The calamari is on point and the steamers are delicious. The lobster roll was pretty good as well. Service was a tad slow this time around but definitely worth the wait . The clam chowder and spicy crab soup are equally delicious.

Traffic on the Belt.  Stopped for a stroll on the pier with the hubby.  Stopped at Randazzo's for an early dinner. A little pricey.  Not terrible.
Excellent lobster bisque, excellent NE clam chowder, excellent stuffed shrimp, and excellent crab cakes.  
Staff friendly.
Bathrooms clean.
Wise stop and dine.

Usually when i used to come here a couple years ago the food was pretty good. I would normally get the lobster fra diavalo and it would be like heaven on earthank. However, this time something was off. I'm not sure if they were having an off day or something but my mom and I both got the same order, the fra diavalo and it was extremely watery. I mean the sauce was so liquidy you could eat it like soup. It like the linguine was drowning in tomato water. The dish tasted fine but the consistency threw me off. Other than that, the service was okay. The waitress was average and came to check on us every so often. I won't be coming back for a while due to the nature of the food during my previous visit, but I hope when I do come back, it's the same food I used to get in the past that I grew up with. ( if you look closely in the photo you can see the gravy like sauce at the bottom)

I got to say I was actually surprised about my experience at this place.  I mean it's an institution that has been around for every, but I don't know why I was riding on the side of caution.  

The place was open and had seating at the bar area and the quite a few tables on the floor.  The raw bar was up to par and the products are manage and kept as required.  We had a dozen little necks and a dozen bluepoint oyster.  Both very, very fresh and tasty.  It's  not a high end place so it's served up on plates without ice.  

After enjoying the raw stuff I had a bowl of the lobster bisque.  It was delicious, creamy and had bits of lobster in the soup.  Also, the soup was piping hot- just how I enjoy my soup.  Usually I find that they're not extremely hot at most restaurants- chowders and bisque.

If your in the area, want to dine at a place that has been around for a long while, enjoy a raw bar and some soups (great for cold days) stop buy.
Traversed the world with privilege to taste many delicious meals. Still come back to the best meals of my life here.
Very good clams and oysters, it is one of my favorite seafood restaurants in Brooklyn

Still the same! A classic! Iconic Brooklyn. Randazzo's is and always will be the place to go for fried calimari. No one even comes close. The sauce hasn't changed-- it's still mind blowing. Everything else is amazing too. For seafood on the bay, Randazzo's does not disappoint.  A must do!
Hi Paulie !! Remember me ? I was friends with Tenutz & Ricky !!! Moved to SoCal in 1983... How ru ?? Always loved the Calamari/Oysters& Clams !! Don

My favorite place for seafood in NYC. The fish is always top quality and the menu is simple but with a great variety. An old fashion counter clam bar with clams on the half shell that are as fresh as possible. They do a fantastic red sauce and all is prepared with Italian recipes. My favorite is the spegetti with white clam sauce that is soaked in a garlic sauce oozing with fresh chopped clams, nothing comes out of a can in this place! I started eating here about 45 years ago and have never walked out dissapointed. Since they are on the water in Sheepshead Bay there are no lack of characters that frequent this establishment but  don't worry, there is no charge for the entertainment. Better than any of the places in City Island and I still can't find a place In Manhattan with this type of food and flair. The prices are not low but no higher than other better restaurants. If you are looking for waiters in white shirts and black pants this is not the place for you, but if its great fresh seafood you're looking for this iconic restaurant across the street from the fishimg boats in Brooklyn brings one of the best dinning experiences in NYC to your table.

I came her with a friend after their doctors visit to grab something to eat for lunch. It has a great family environment. A little chaotic with the owner(?) and waitresses (?) children/grandchildren running around. I had the lobster randazzo; which included a full lobster (well seasoned), clams, and shrimp with linguini. I have never been to a place where I liked their clams and here was no exception. As for the shrimp, it left little to be desired but it was still doable. Now for their linguini, the noodles were good but I didn't really like the sauce which had  a hint of lemon in it. I don't really like many things with lemon on it. But the most important part was that the lobster tasted juicy and fresh!!
As for my friend he has shell food allergies but insisted on trying their lobster tail which was a South African lobster tail. They had the lobster tail, which was decently sized in this sort of lemon inspired sauce (I'm starting to think they have a thing for lemons). Needless to say he didn't like the sauce. It was too lemony and a bit bland. After tasting a piece of his, can agree that the lobster tasted overcooked and the sauce wasn't helping.
We both had appetizers. Mines was the combo with mussels, scangilli, shrimp, and calamari. As far as I'm concerned calamari is like a redeeming quality for me. If the calamari doesn't taste good, then your doing something wrong. But the calamari was the best thing I had. As for my friend he had the mussels and calamari. He had a slight dislike for the sauce the mussels were in but loved the mussels either way. And yeah he liked the calamari as well. 
In total everything came out to be close to 200  (so he says cause he insisted on paying for it and not letting me see the bill). We both felt it was a little over priced considering we didn't really like the food that much (mainly the sauce though). But considering my food was a little better than his I am giving this only 3 stars and I will try and come back to see if my next dish improves my opinion.

Very old place right on the Bay. 
People come here mostly for fresh blue point oysters. 
All year round it's available here. 
We ordered Steamed mussels in white sauce and stuffed shrimps with French fries. 
Everything came super fast. Food was freshly made and portions were pretty large. 
Shrimps were well done but still crunchy on the edge and no as oily as I thought they would be. 
Price wasn't cheap but it was worth every bite.  
Downside.....there was no dessert. Oh, well... since the place smells with seafood inside out, dessert kind of doesn't belong here...lol.

Charming- Warrm & Food is Aahmazing!  Deliciously ridiculous calamari with hot or medium sauce. Was not disappointed with the Shrimp Scampi  Marechiara pasta dish was also enjoyed and also a great selection of wines. Dried zucchini and cold antipasta were very satisfying.  Service was very good and great evening all around.

For get about it
I love this old school brooklyn place 
The best sea food in Brooklyn 
It took me back 30 years and still great food
A fun place and great food

Very good seafood, not to cheap but worth it

Interior could use some freshening up for sure, feels like an old diner

Usually just order a soup (sometimes go for dinner)
But I am a huge fan of the New England clam chowder, very hearty and fresh. The lobster Bisque is also very good. Always nice waitresses and deff recommend eating here if you love seafood

This is a local seafood spot, well known. Have had several dinners here throughout the years. I was a bit disappointed but I want to acknowledge the highlights first. The New England clam chowder was great as always, consistently the cup of soup you came for. The little neck baked clams were very crispy not soggy. The fried calamari or I should says galamad*, was definitely prepared in a nice clean oil with fresh squid. The nice touch was a thick piece of bread to soak up the grease from the calamari. The sauce was perfect, personally don't like when I get spicy sauce on the side which is subjective but I was pleased to be able to dunk right it. Now for the entree's.. myself and 2 others ordered the stuffed lobster for $40 each and one other guest with ya got the stuffed shrimp. The waitress was very sweet and went over the market price for several items and gave nice recommendations. I asked what's in the stuffing she did a nice job of explaining. What wasn't clear was that you get what felt like a pound of chopped seafood in your lobster. The lobster itself was so over cooked. Across the board all 3 stuffed lobsters were over cooked and tasteless. So chewy and tough your gums hurt after trying to get through the tail. The stuffing wasn't bad, it was over salted though,and just over powering the dish. I'm not sure if it's just us or the entree was more about the stuffing than the lobster. At $40 and coming to a seafood joint, the main event is my lobsta! Now the stuffed shrimp were great, also too overstuffed but the shrimp itself at least was cooked well. The sides were delicious, the fried zucchini was perfect, so pretty, prepared in clean oil, and you get a heaping amount. The baked potato was very nice, came on its own plate with the condiments needed which is really appreciated for the dining experience. The drinks- the soda is the classic Coca-Cola small glass bottle, barely much in there and you need at least 2 to get through a meal, not worth the price. The bathroom was so filthy oh my god. I hate to say this it gives me no joy, but please clean the bathroom. People are spending hundreds of dollars on dinner the least you can do is mop the bathroom floor and put some kind of scented item in there to cancel out the foul odor. It wasn't even the smell of feces it was just that disgusting non sanitized restroom smell. Reservations- we called ahead asking for reservation for 4. They didn't take a name, or number, just said yea sure sweet heart come on over. We figured since the reservation request was for 20 minutes later they didn't need any of that info. But when we got there no reservation was acknowledged and we still had to wait. Waiting is sometimes a part of dining and completely fair, but acknowledging a reservation when one does not exist is misleading. Despite the flaws, those appetizers were very good, and the service was really nice and honestly I say this time and time again, service will make people come back to give it another chance. So the 4 stars may seem generous based on review but keep in mind this is a spot that has been around for generations and deserves credit for still keeping it going and delivering some good food and good service.
I can never go wrong with two favorite dishes, souppa de mussels and Clam chowder!! Absolutely love this place, I am never disappointed
Staple in the neighborhood. Raw bar is a must. Fried calamari with hot marinara hits the spot. Lobster bisque one of the best I ever had. Visit often.

MEDIOCORE SEAFOOD with CITY ISLAND prices. I had stuffed shrimp( supposed to be stuffed with crab meat and baby shrimps) however I only saw baby shrimps and breadcrumbs. The bowl of stuffed shrimp had so much water in it o had to pour it out into the bowl underneath. Lack seasoning and flavor!

Got food poisoning last week when I was there for lunch. Ordered the baked clams and New England soup. New England soup was good which is why I'm not giving them a 1 star. It's funny because they have a sign that says "fresh seafood isn't cheap and cheap seafood isn't fresh"... why I'm I paying so much for this seafood then? Very disappointed in the quality I received.

Also I know it was the clams because my mom and I shared a large soup and she did not have the clams, just soup, and no food poisoning for her.

Horrible experience. First time ever experiencing a form of racism in a Resteraunt!!! My family and I ordered several of the dishes on the menu. The calamari was not to my liking and was not prepared right or the way I asked so I requested the waitress to return it and I'd order something else. She came back with the manager who proceeded to say "So what's wrong with your calamari this is the best calamari in Brooklyn, never had any complaints and nothing is wrong with it and I don't play that" proceeded to cancel the rest of our order plus and our additional "to go" order  without letting us know. Basically asked us to leave, only because we returned the calamari. No one else was treated this way and we happened to be the only people of color eating there at the time. We told him everything else was fine, he stuck with leaving our order canceled and was very rude. Working in customer service/hospitality his whole domineer was unprofessional and unnecessary. I will never spend my hard earned money in an establishment that treats me like I'm insignificant. Would not suggest this place to anyone!

I'm giving these guys two stars for the good service because the waiters and waitresses are nice. Besides the clam bar, the food is bland. If you really want to be disappointed, get the lobster roll, it's delicious.

This place has so much potential, but unfortunately is extremely mediocre. Sheepshead Bay is the perfect location for a seafood restaurant, but they serve flavorless, uninspired food. 

They should go to City Island in the Bronx and take down some pointers. 

Randazzo's seafood should be fresher & more flavorful.
Terrible service. Frozen seafood at fresh seafood prices - the calamari and shrimp were like ice cubes. Owners have a terrible attitude. There are much better options in Brooklyn.
Horrible experience service was poor my food was served with a band aid in it I will not be returning back inside was very old and run down such a shame it usto be a nice place

I had a horrible experience when I went here last week. The service was terrible. The staff all had nasty attitudes and my food had a long hair in it almost like a black girls weave. I do not recommend anyone eating this nasty food

Came here on a whim after hearing so much about it. Even when I lived in the Bronx my grandma would mention driving down to Brooklyn for this, which speaks to its legacy and demand. That being said, it was destined to be tried. 

We started with a large calamari dish, for me, reminiscent of the late Roccos Calamari(if youre from the bay ridge/dyker heights area). This is soft, tender, incredibly fried calamari with a well complimenting tomato sauce.

Entree wise, my uncle had a lobster roll, one of the biggest I have seen, for a great price point. I have never seen this man unable to finish food, but when we found him picking off bread to maximize lobster, we knew this was the one. Other than that, I had the stuffed shrimp, and honestly it was disappointing. Every other dish came as a great portion size and was very well presented. This was meh. Decent flavor, and then shrimp is shrimp, its always good but so much more could be done with this.

The days winner by far was my wifes seafood fra diavolo that had her pulling out full lobster tails. This is honestly for two people. I literally took half, including all mussels and clams, and not only was she full, but she had some to take home. Well after we crossed the finish line, we were still sliding bread through that delicious sauce.

Greatly appreciated good food and hospitality, now I know where to go when in the sheepshead bay area.

Randazzo's has the best seafood by far. I've been coming here for over many years and I absolutely enjoy the quality of the food that they serve us. This is the only legit Italian seafood spot that you could find on sheepshead Bay.

Ok people I am having a major party in mouth this food is freakin amazing.    The raw cherry clams are big melt right in my mouth omg.   I am also tremendously enjoying my salad with grilled salmon.  The salmon is grilled to perfection it's does not need seasoning yes it tender and tasty.     
  
The  presentation of the food was very nice I love the old fashion plates, and bowls very authentic.


The last time I was here was decades ago it has not changed which positive.  This my old school Brooklyn Italian style restaurant I love it.   

The. Service was the best friendly truly giving great recommendations of the food at this restaurant kudos to her.

Old school all the way.  Fresh fish simply prepared. What more do you want. This place has been here forever and the interior shows it. But you come for the food.
We just got left off and this was the first stop we made. Made us very happy. Reminded me of my old days

We are here today, haven't been there in about 25 years or more. We rarely get into Brooklyn lately. The food is just as good as I remember if not better and our waitress was professional, friendly, and made us feel right at home.

We haved to visit more often

This is one of my favorite local spot. I love their lemon grilled chicken, Randazzo's pasta, New England clam chowder. The seafood is always fresh, never disappointed every time when I come here. This is family runs business, and they have been there more than 30+ year, the food is not cheap here but you get the quality. The service is normally as what you will expected. This is not a fine dining space, but if you want something true Italian seafood bar. Then this is the right place for you. 

Give them a try if you are in the area, I am assure you that you won't regret.

I recently had a dinner at Randazzo's. I came in with my Girlfriend. I have been coming to Randazzo's since I was a kid. Always liked it and always knew what to expect until this night. We ordered our meal and proceeded to eat. One of the dishes we ordered was not good . It was the fresh crab appetizer. It was actually terrible. It had no flavor and tasted kind of "off". I asked the waitress if she would take it back and let us order something else. She was totally annoyed and took it grudgingly. We were waiting for her to return and I could see her standing off to the side drinking a glass of water ignoring us. When I finally got her attention she was again acting annoyed. I asked to see the manager. She came over and actually said to me that she knew my girlfriend and I were going to to be trouble the minute we walked in. Do you believe the audacity of this woman!? I have been dining here for decades without incident. This was a ridiculous situation. We didn't bother ordering anything else. Frankly we just wanted to leave. When the waitress brought over our bill the crab appetizer was still on the bill. I told her I would not pay for something that was so terrible. I told her it was tasteless. She asked me what I expected from canned crabmeat!! Can you believe it. I said the menu says fresh. That's why I ordered it. This behavior is unacceptable. When she finally brought over the corrected bill she slammed it down on the table and said to me " by the way , you could do a lot better.... indicating my choice in girlfriends. I could have jumped across the table but I am a gentleman. We paid the check and left. I have never been so insulted in my life.  These two employees were totally unprofessional and rude. The idea that they could speak to paying customers this way is appalling. You can rest assured that I will NEVER return. They have lost my business for good. I know a lot of people. People who are frequent customers of Randazzo's. I will be telling them all about this. They won't be back either.

HORRIBLE FOOD & LOUSY SERVICE.. was there this past Saturday for dinner, the waitress looked like she didnt want to serve us, there was only three of us so it wasnt too much work for her. she took our order and didnt ask if we wanted anything to drink, calamari was small portion (in a dessert dish) two tiny pieces of bread with it, they were soaked with water. My fried shrimp order was small portion maybe only 5 or 6 small shrimp (no taste, hard, over cooked, dried) Fries were good. My son and his wife order the Shrimp Scampi with Linguine HORRIBLE! shrimp were very very small and well over cooked, No TASTE! No Flavor,  like if they were sitting in Lipton soup.  Waitress was no were near the table or within reach.. Asked a waiter if he could bring some bread, they were even able to eat their meals.. WASTE of money ! not like they were many years ago, cheap with their portions too! a small bottle of Coke $3.00!  I DO NOT reccomend Randazzo's Clam Bar

My boyfriend and I love this place and we travel from jersey to eat here. Well On Father's Day we couldn't get a spot so we did take our. Well order was messed up on EVERYTHING. We threw out 60$ worth of food. I tried to find a website to email and they don't have one. I went in today 6/30. 2 weeks not 4 like owners son says and I told them what happened. Well I got an attitude from owners daughter that she can't do "anything" since I didn't call that day. Are you kidding me? I am in the restaurant business for 23 years and she messed everything up in the first place. She couldn't even replace the soup she gave me wrong. Yet she drives away in a jaguar SUV. yeah place would have closed down if I got a soup or calamari to make me happy. I WILL NEVER GIVE THEM ANOTHER DOLLAR. THEY SHOULD BE ASHAMED OF THEIR POOR BUSINESS CHOICES.

Been here before and good food, plus service was always on point. Somehow tonight was a big disappointment. Was trying to wrap my mind around if it was because we were sitting outside instead of inside. We came especially for the steamer and it was mushy and Tasteless and falling apart. That was even fine but just wanted to inform the staff, but what really threw us off was the waitress that we barely came to the table. She told us that she will tell the manager.  OK.. and then nothing. Never came back to check on us. Didnt even bringing water to the table or utensils. Did not bother taking the steamers away. Very dismissive waitress and not attentive at all. Definitely would not come.

It's always a place to go to since my childhood. It's also my Dad's favorite restaurant. He had me tried raw cherry stone clams for the very first time at this place and I love it ever since. Then we moved abroad. It's been more than 10 years since my last visit. My Dad passed away four years ago, so coming back to this place really means a lot to me. I associated food with fond memories of my childhood. 

I brought my husband with me. It's his first time here. I ordered my dad's favorite dishes, fried calamari with marinara sauce, half a dozen of cherry stone clams, shrimp scampi, and clam chowder. The taste of the food and the restaurant settings made me feel that my dad was still sitting next to me. It was as good as how I remember it. 

I'll be moving away again. But if I'm back to New York, I'd visit Randazzo's clam bar for sure.o
The best sauce I have tasted at any restaurant period! paired w/ fresh seafood ,  what else can you ask for - one of the few places I crave!

I do not recommend this restaurant. The food is not all that appetizing. The taste and quality of the food is not worth the prices that they charge. I ate it because I was hungry, but the whole experience of dining at Randazzo's was disappointing. The service was horrible. Our waitress had an attitude every time she came to the table. Her attitude was the beginning of our unpleasant experience. I actually should have went with my first instinct and left after the first time she came to the table. I came to this restaurant with great expectations, but now feel completely let down. My family, who was also with me, feel the same way. We will not return here again.

The worst shrimp cocktail I've ever had. Shrimp was of a sufficient size, but had absolutely no taste even after I sprinkled it with salt and pepper, lemon juice, and dipped in the pretty pathetic cocktail sauce it came with!

I was very disappointed with the Shrimp Randazzo. Since the dish contained the name of the restaurant I expected something special. The sauce on the linguine was bland. I ended up just picking out the shrimp. The only reason I gave them 2 stars was because my daughter enjoyed the Colassol Shrimp with fried zucchini and because the waitress was nice. I won't go again.

This is an old school establishment that people must have nostalgic memories about but it was a very underwhelming experience. Expect to spend $25 for a plate of deep fried, tasteless fish. It honestly should have been half the price and even then, the food still would have been underwhelming. Just go somewhere else. Randazzo's isn't worth the money or the calories.
Delicious food . A bit pricey nice location . Variety of seafood dishes many non seafood options as well.

Ok for starters service was not the best but I guess tolerable... oysters were great and fresh.  Crab legs not the best.  Mozzarella sticks tasted like supermarket frozen type!!! Decor was like being in a big lunch room...

First time I have been here in about a year,I'm getting the filet, my cousins are getting the rigatoni with chicken and vodka sauce, and the spaghetti with marinara sauce.
Our food was delicious as expected, and service was excellent.
Was cool here!! Service and food could've been a little better i will say! It was a great experience though!

We just came from Randazzo's (our absolutely favorite place in the area).
Were seated momentarily. A waitress approached us and for some strange reason literally ran her hand through my son's hair (he has a curly hair). It wouldn't be right in any case. But my son is 23 years old and not a baby. I guess she tried to be friendly. But it was the same hand she is carried all plates with. Kind of dirty...
All of us felt disgusted.
As of food - oysters were looking good but all of them had small pieces of shells in them. Little necks were terrible.
Fried calamari - soggy. :(
Overall - terrible experience.
P.S. My son wanted to talk to the manager but no one came to him to talk. So when we came home he left a negative review on Yelp. Then he called Randazzo's and ask them to speak to the manager.
The manager (a lady) said she read his review already and she hopes he'll get a food poisoning.
As you understand we'll never go there.

Came here for a date night. We had dinner here the night we got engaged almost 11 years ago to the day. Food was great ! No frills, yummy options and great location.  The sauce is perfect, I love the spicy type. Check them out!

Small, casual, somewhat cafeteria-looking and utterly iconic.  It's one of those places that's definitively Brooklyn.  I regard this as "New York City iconic" as Carnegie Deli or Balthazar.  They were MIA for a year after hurricane Sandy, and I thanked the Gods when they came back.

The food here is A+.  Unlike 90% of all the Italian restaurants in NYC, their sauce isn't sh*t.  This place has great sauce: one taste, and you'll understand why the sell it in take-home jars.

The sauces are great, and the seafood is utterly fresh.  A meal here really hits the spot if you're hankering for shellfish.

I honestly don't understand how this restaurant isn't 5/5 stars by anyone's standards.  The waitresses can be a little cheeky in an old-school Italian kind of way, but that's part of the charm of this iconic clam bar.


Little Necks: A+
Cherry Stones A-
Oysters: A+
Just... perfection.  Fresh, clean tasting, and almost cathartic.  As far as I'm concerned, the best in NYC.  You'll want to load them up with the following (in order):
1. horseradish
2. shrimp cocktail sauce
3. Squeezed lemon juice
4. An oyster cracker for the clams, two oyster crackers for the oyster.
There's a bit too much meat on the cherry stones for my liking: still delicious, but your chew is mostly clam rather than an amalgam of clam with accoutrements.

Shrimp Cocktail: A
Beautiful, humongous, soft, tasty shrimp.  Phenomenal cocktail sauce.  The best.

Lobster Fra Diavolo: A+
I've had an awful lot of Fra Diavolo in my life, and this is one of the best.  The secret?  Their sauce.  It's tremendous!  I'd say medium to light on the heat index.  If you're ok with semi-spicy food, you can order this and let them use their default spice level.  Pro-Tip: They create the sauce from scratch when you order the dish.  If you like sauces, I would order this dish "with extra, extra sauce" to make sure you get enough sauce.  Seriously, it's stupid good.

Marinated Burned Chicken: C
Sauce is very good; it tastes like a butter and wine sauce (I was expecting marinara so this was a surprise and I ended up liking it).  However, the chicken was unforgivably dry.  Some pieces were OK, but the majority of it had to be choked down with water.  I'm not sure whether it was overcooked at the outset or simply warmed in a microwave for too long, but either way, this dish is no bueno.  No amount of sauce would've helped this dish.

Stuffed Filet: A+
This is flounder stuffed with crab meat and tiny shrimp.  Nicely charred on the outside, a delicious sauce that can hardly be believed.  The dish is juicy and delicious.  It's as good as my mom used to make it.

this place has very bad customer service & cleanliness. i walked in and had to stand there for over 5 minutes & actually had to ask the guy playing in his nose can i place an order , he took my order so im figuring he's gonna go tell the cooks my order being it's my first time at the restaurant. he walks over & pull shrimp out the fridge & put them in batter with the same dirty hands he was digging in his nose with, without washing his hands or putting on gloves.  i walked out the restaurant without saying anything & they will never get business from me !!!!!!!!!!!!
I have been coming to Randazzo's Clam Bar for years!! The food is amazing! Will always be my go-to place for fresh seafood!

I really regret not taking a picture of the food, because it LOOKED so good!!!! Ok...my husband had the combo (shrimp, calamari, clams and scungili) and said he's never seen black conch (scungili) before. He also said he should have 2nd guessed ordering it once the waitress said "you like that!?" BUT.....he said everything else was decent, just odd that the seafood was laid out over a hard piece of bread and not over linguini or spaghetti.....ok my dish. Sigh. I decided to play it safe and get the fried shrimp and french fries - because, after all, we were right on the water so how bad could THAT be!? Well.....the shrimp tasted like what I would imagine fried styrofoam peanuts would taste like: NOTHING!!! No seasoning, no nada. No salt nor lemon could save them. The tartar sauce wasn't even homemade, which would have totally saved them. I'm not the type to carry seasonings in my bag, but this time some Old Bay would have been PERFECT!!! They looked good though. Fried to perfection but.....anyone who says this food is good, likes food with zero seasoning or has zero tastebuds because....this ain't it.....and for $70 and no alcoholic beverages, I would have expected a basket of bread or a salad to come with the meal but NOPE!  Oh....the service was good (because it was empty as hell in there) and the mozzarella sticks were good. Other than that....nope.

Landmark restaurant basically on Emmons ave. Stop in on a Sunday or Monday expecting the same fresh seafood merch. Pauli's hollering is heard and grandma's portrait hangs before the kitchen. Yup, that's the place.

We had taken my mother -- a New Yorker living in Georgia -- on a 'this is your life' car trip around Brooklyn.  It culminated at Randazzo's, a clam bar that's been around I think longer than me... and I'm old!

I recently saw Randazzo's calamari on a list of 50 Iconic Restaurant Dishes, so ordering a portion was a no-brainer.  One can get either a spicy or medium hot sauce.  We chose medium.  The calamari was crisp and good -- but iconic.....?  That would be a stretch.

We all got clams which we slurped down.  I was happy with the white wine and garlic sauce.  My husband, sampling my mother's, said next time he'll order their richer, red sauce. Red or white,  both were great to sop up bread.

While it's a laid back, bare bones dining room, the place isn't cheap.  And the portions, as you can see in my clam photo, aren't particularly generous.  But Randazzo's is a Sheepshead Bay institution, that continues to attract people from all over.   We even saw a popular millennial television actress walk in on our way out.
This is unfortunately one of the onli Italian restraunts ofcorse with great seafood and I can't call it this neighborhood just went too shit I'm just being honest god bless America

The service was terrible. Everyone is on their phone. Even my change was wrong. $20 short. The food is terrific. But the service was so bad I don't think I will go back. You would get better service if you sent the waitress a text.

I drove 16 miles for Sunday brunch at sheepshead bay, Randazzo's an iconic restaurant to " déguster " fresh seafood.
I ordered the fried calamari for starter, the deep tomatoes sauce unbelievably delicious and stimulates appetite, no need for aperitifs...
The main course was lobster Fra Diavolo, a mixture of shrimp, clams, mussels and a whole lobster in deep red sauce on the bed of spaghetti, holy goodness I loved the oversized and generous portion, I had great time even though the food was excellent, the overall service need improvement
Old school to the fullest. Any place I can get stuffed fish and a miller highlife is where my heart can rest and my waistline can quit.

I was curious to try a red sauce place and a good review in the New York Times sent me here. We waited a very long time for service, and did not find it charming when it was as grumpy as Brooklyn is supposed to be. Our food was dumped in front of us, literally, and there was a finger print in red sauce on the side of both bowls where the waitresses hand had gone into the food. Makes you wonder about hygiene. It is also very expensive for what you get. We ate calamari. It was covered in red sauce. While we ate a cook stood in the door yelling to a waitress across the room. Been there, done that, don't have to do it again.
New England clam chowder is still the best in Brooklyn all the years coming here nothing has changed thank goodness,,,, still a must when in ships at bay

Me and my fiancé drove an hour and a half to come here. He hadn't stopped talking about it being he used to come all the time as a kid. We were NOT disappointed! We started off with the baked clams which were amazing! Then for our entrees we did the pasta with lobster sauce and the pasta with shrimp sauce. OUTSTANDING. Met all of my expectations and will be looking for an excuse just to come back.

Passed through sheepshead bay Brooklyn  , and purposely landed here at Randazzo's for a yummy quick bite.
We had the spicy seafood soup, omgosh  so yummy, and baked clams . Absolutely  delicious , can't wait to go back . A bit pricy $18 "That's allota CLAMS for just 10". But worth it!

Wow from years ago to now randazzos has definitely gone down hill. I refuse to spend my well earned money on their horrible food. My sister went last week and they actually wrapped up empty clam shells with bakes clams that weren't touched! Overpriced and disgusting

Spicy crab corn chowder is awesome...baked clams and lobster bisque were not so good.  The calamari is great but it's a rip off because they place the fried calamari on a really really small plate and underneath the calamari are two hunks of Italian bread..so it looks like you are getting a decent portion but you are not..and it's 14 dollars on top of it. Such a blatant rip off.

Ever craved delicious seafood and Italian food but minus the pretentious white tablecloth restaurant vibe?  Came here during the middle of the week expecting to be the only person dining in and to my surprise other people were dinning in as well. I knew I didn't come here to play any games so I ordered a couple of things!  I ordered a lobster roll (really good) lump crab meat also really good and the broiled lobster definitely not the best I had (too I also had mozzarella sticks and French fries and a salad (judge your mother).You would want to be as comfortable as possible when eating here the portions are really big al la Italian style. Though I was disappointed about my overcooked lobster, I would still recommend and come back. Definitely suggest coming here in your sweatpants and hoodie like I did so you can leave with your food baby comfortably in tow.

The night my family and I came here to eat was a last minute change of places, but a great one. Out waitress was so helpful and nice. Brought over a pitcher of water the second we sat down, ever restaurant should do that! It was only 3 of us and we definitely ordered more than enough. The fried zucchini and salad came out very quick. The Randazzo's pasta combo and shrimp dish we ordered came out as we were finishing the appetizer. Talk about perfect timing. If we lived closed we would probably be regulars! Highly highly recommend!!

Great place for seafood just pretty pricey be ready to spend $50 per person but you'll be eating lobster and shrimp their sauce is also excellent. Little bottle of Coke they have it three dollars each

Randazzo's serves up some fresh, delicious clams! Do it right and start yourself with some. They have a good variety of drinks. Atmosphere is like an open and casual takeout spot. It's unfortunate that two of my favorites, New England Clam Chowder and Linguine in White Clam Sauce are not that good here. But I really came here for the raw clams. Tried their Seafood Fra Diavlo (MP was $50) and it's amazing! I feel some type of way with tomato sauce, I'm usually a white sauce pasta person. However, this tomato sauce was not tart, slightly sweet and has the perfect pinch of spice, acidity and density. Totally recommend it.

It's been a while since I been here. I remember the calamari with the marinara was the highlight of the meal. It taste really good. It was perfectly fried and the sauce went well with it. I also had the raw clam and pasta. Good times. The restaurant was packed but the wait wasn't too bad. This was right by the water. The decor was dated but the food was good.

I decided to "support my local business" during quarantine time due to COVID-19. I ordered a chicken Parmesan and clam chowder. Neither one was spectacular but imagine my frustration when I found a hair in my clam chowder. It's not as if they have so many people to worry about but they still couldn't get basic food preparation right. Waste of time and a complete waste of money.

Especially during the quarantine, it's great to be able to go to Randazzo's and get little necks on the half shell, baked clams, and the fabulous fried calamari with hot sauce! Thank you for the party in my mouth! It lifted my spirits! Thanks to all of you for working through this to feed us!

What can you say about this place? It's been get a forever, it's a staple. Seafood is good as always and the old school ambiance is really why you are there. If you are visiting Brooklyn, you have to come here at least once
Not only did it take 40 minutes to get our order they gave it away to somebody else. But when it finally arrived it was fantastic

Went to Randazzo's for the first time since Covid19.I was very pleased that they are open for business.
Take out orders only.
I got the fried shrimp with medium sauce.
They are very well organized and I only had to wait about 5 minutes to have my food.
It was delicious

I was so excited to introduce my husband to Randazzo's as he's never had it before. We ordered for pick-up and drove over to get it. 

Besides the lack of masks and the outdoor eating (to which there's a sign posted that there is no outside seating), the people working the window barely were using masks. 

We get the food home and we're even more disappointed. The food was bland at best. The breading on the calamari had no seasoning whatsoever. The shrimp scampi tasted like someone dumping a bunch of lemon flavored water on top of it. My husbands meal was "eh" at best. 

This place used to be amazing. Very very disappointed.

My girlfriend took me the after raving about this place.  I'm sooooo glad she did - the food is absolutely delicious!

Since you still can't eat inside restaurants in NYC I was glad there was outdoor tables.  You place your order at the window and hopefully find a place to sit.

I ordered the New England Clam Chowder soup and shrimp parmigiana with spaghetti.  My girlfriends ordered two dozen cherry neck clams and we shared everything.  Can I say those were the freshest clams I think I have ever eaten.  They were so good that I got a 1/2 dozen as well.  The soup was to die for (I ordered a small and regretted not getting a large).  The shrimp parm and spaghetti was delicious as well!  I was sooooo stuffed but very happy when I left.

Let me say that this place isn't cheap, but it's definitely worth the price.  So much so that we're planning on going back there again this weekend!
its pretty good. i hate that yelp makes me post more characters even tho this is all I have to say.

Too much bread in every dish.. Everything tasteless... only sauce can help and still ... the taste of the dishes are not good. The best were fried calamari. Staffed shrimp and Clams - just awful... If you looking for the junk food, better go to Macdonalds. If you are looking for the high class restaurant, choose one with Michelin Star.

Came for a night out with friends and my order was wrong the person  that answered the phone insisted that she gave me the right order  after she lost my slip. She ended up giving me the vodka sauce to put on my meal instead of changing my order. Tne food is okay but due to customer service I would not return.
